Job Description – Service Delivery \& Operations Coordinator (Fresher)

**Company:** Cloudviyug Technologies  
**Location:** Coimbatore (Hiybrid)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** Freshers (0–1 Year)

About Cloudviyug Technologies

Cloudviyug Technologies is a cloud consulting and managed services company specializing in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). We help organizations migrate, modernize, secure, optimize, and manage their cloud infrastructure through Cloud Consulting, DevOps, Kubernetes, Cloud Security, Cost Optimization, Disaster Recovery, and 24×7 Managed Services.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail\-oriented individual to work closely with the Founder and leadership team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys coordinating people, managing operations, and ensuring excellent customer service.

Role Summary

The Service Delivery \& Operations Coordinator will act as the central coordination point between customers, cloud engineers, management, and internal teams. The role involves service delivery coordination, executive assistance, recruitment support, HR administration, and operational planning to ensure smooth day\-to\-day business operations.

No prior cloud or technical experience is required. Comprehensive training will be provided.

Key ResponsibilitiesService Delivery Coordination

* Schedule customer meetings, project reviews, and internal discussions.
* Attend customer meetings and prepare detailed Minutes of Meeting (MoM).
* Track action items and ensure timely follow\-up with internal teams.
* Coordinate communication between customers and cloud engineers.
* Monitor service requests and ensure timely completion.
* Maintain customer documentation and service records.

Operations Coordination

* Coordinate daily activities of cloud engineering teams.
* Assist in shift planning and resource scheduling.
* Validate employee timesheets and attendance.
* Maintain leave records and coordinate leave approvals.
* Track task status and escalate delays where necessary.
* Support onboarding and offboarding activities.

Recruitment \& HR Support

* Coordinate interview schedules and candidate communication.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Coordinate with job portals and recruitment consultants.
* Support new employee onboarding documentation.
* Assist in employee engagement and HR administrative activities.

Executive Support

* Manage the Founder's calendar and meeting schedules.
* Coordinate business travel, accommodation, and travel itineraries.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and meeting documents.
* Track business commitments and important deadlines.
* Organize confidential business documents and records.

Customer Communication

* Serve as the coordination contact for customers regarding meetings and follow\-ups.
* Ensure timely communication between customers and internal teams.
* Maintain professional communication via email, phone, and virtual meetings.
* Escalate critical customer issues to management.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in BBA, BBM, B.Com, MBA, BE, B.Tech, or any equivalent discipline.
* Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience are welcome to apply.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Willingness to learn cloud technologies and IT service delivery.

Desired Skills

* Strong attention to detail.
* Professional and confident communication.
* Positive attitude with a willingness to learn.
* Excellent follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Good time management and ownership of responsibilities.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

What You Will Learn

* IT Service Delivery Management
* Customer Relationship Management
* Cloud Computing Fundamentals (AWS, Azure \& GCP)
* Project Coordination
* Recruitment Coordination
* Business Operations
* Executive Office Management
* Professional Communication
* Documentation \& Reporting
* Team Coordination

Career Growth

This role offers a structured career path into:

* Service Delivery Coordinator
* Operations Executive
* Customer Success Executive
* Project Coordinator
* Service Delivery Manager
* Operations Manager

Why Join Cloudviyug Technologies?

* Work directly with the Founder and leadership team.
* Gain exposure to enterprise cloud consulting and managed services.
* Learn business operations and customer management.
* Receive mentorship from experienced cloud professionals.
* Excellent career growth opportunities in a rapidly growing technology company.

Compensation

title: Administration Assistant
description:

o Oversee the entire onboarding process for new employees, from pre\-joining documentation to the first day of work.

o Prepare and organize new hire kits, which may include Company Brochure, office supplies, laptop/computer setup/Mobile/Sim/Skype id/Email id’s etc.

2\. Induction and Orientation:

o Schedule and facilitate new employee orientation sessions, introducing them to the company culture, policies, and key personnel.

o Provide new hires with a tour of the office, explaining facilities and workspaces.

o Ensure new employees are introduced to relevant departments and teams, and assist them in understanding their role and responsibilities.

3\. System Access and Account Setup:

o Coordinate with IT and other relevant departments to ensure that new employees are set up with necessary system access (email, software, internal tools, etc.).

o Assist new hires with logging into company systems, setting up accounts, and familiarizing them with company platforms.

Communication and Follow\-up:

o Send new joiner email to all staff with details regarding their first day (schedule, designation, reporting person, office location, etc)

o Follow up with new hires during their first week to ensure a smooth transition and address any concerns they may have.

Employee Records Management:

o Maintain up\-to\-date records of all new employee documentation, including signed contracts, and required documents.

o Ensure that all new hire records are compliant with company policies and legal requirements.

Feedback and Improvement:

o Collect feedback from new employees on their onboarding experience and suggest improvements to HR or management.

o Assist in improving onboarding materials and processes to create a more efficient and welcoming experience for future hires.

Appointment Letter Preparation:

o Prepare and draft appointment letters for new employees across all branches.

o Ensure that all required information (e.g., job title, salary, joining date, terms and conditions) is accurately reflected in the appointment letters.

o Tailor appointment letters to meet specific requirements for different branches, if necessary, while adhering to company\-wide standards.

Coordination with HR \& Branch Managers:

o Coordinate with the HR department and branch managers to confirm the details of new hires, ensuring that all necessary information is included in the appointment letter.

o Ensure that the appointment letters align with company policies, job roles, and branch\-specific guidelines.

Issuing Appointment Letters:

o Distribute appointment letters to new employees in a timely manner, both physically and digitally, depending on the branch's location and the employee’s preference.

o Ensure that appointment letters are signed by authorized personnel and returned for documentation and filing.

o Track the issuance of appointment letters to ensure that they are sent out on time and any delays are addressed promptly.

Repair and Maintenance Scheduling:

o Coordinate with internal departments to identify the need for repair work and ensure that vendors are scheduled accordingly.

o Oversee the scheduling of repairs and maintenance, ensuring minimal disruption to the daily operations of the office.

o Ensure that all repair work is completed in a timely manner, following agreed\-upon deadlines.

Monitoring Repair Work:

o Supervise and monitor the progress of repair and maintenance work to ensure that it is completed to the required standard and in a timely fashion.

o Conduct periodic inspections to confirm that repairs meet company quality standards and safety regulations.

o Address any delays or issues with the vendors to avoid further disruptions.

 Inventory Tracking and Control:

o Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of stock inventory, including office supplies, materials, and equipment.

o Monitor stock levels to ensure sufficient quantities are available for day\-to\-day operations.

o Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile discrepancies between physical stock and recorded data.

o Implement stock rotation systems to minimize waste and ensure the proper use of resources.

o Coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of stock and resolve any issues related to orders or shipments.

o Ensure the efficient distribution of stock across various departments based on their needs and usage patterns.

o Allocate inventory to internal departments and ensure they receive the materials or products in a timely manner.

o Maintain clear records of stock distribution to track usage by different departments.

Cost Control and Budgeting:

o Track and manage stock\-related expenses, ensuring adherence to the department’s budget.

o Help identify opportunities for cost savings, such as bulk ordering, negotiating better prices, or reducing waste.

o Report any budget discrepancies to senior management and recommend corrective actions.

o Maintain proper documentation for stock transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, delivery receipts, and inventory logs.

o Ensure all inventory records are properly filed and accessible for auditing and future reference.

o Maintain up\-to\-date records for compliance and reporting purposes.

Asset Tracking \& Maintenance:

o Maintain an up\-to\-date register of all company assets (e.g., PCs, laptops, mobile phones, SIM cards, etc.).

o Record and track asset serial numbers, model details, condition, location, and assigned employees.

o Update and monitor the asset management system or spreadsheet regularly.

o Assist in the allocation of new assets to employees and ensure proper documentation.

o Conduct periodic physical audits to verify the accuracy of asset records.

o Manage the disposal of old or unused assets in accordance with company policies.

o Generate and maintain regular reports on asset allocation, usage, and status.

o Keep records of all asset transfers, returns, and repairs.

o Prepare and submit periodic asset status reports to management.

Backup Systems:

o Regularly back up critical documents, files, and data using secure cloud storage or physical storage devices/Hard disk etc.

o Ensure that backup systems are properly functioning and up\-to\-date, conducting routine checks to prevent data loss.

o Implement an organized backup schedule for daily, weekly, and monthly document backups, ensuring comprehensive protection for all critical information.

 Disaster Recovery Planning:

o Develop and implement backup and disaster recovery plans to ensure that office documentation is recoverable in the event of data loss or hardware failure.

o Test and evaluate recovery plans periodically to ensure quick and efficient document restoration during emergencies.

o Collaborate with various departments to ensure all important documents are backed up and stored appropriately.

o Assist team members with retrieving documents and files from the backup system when necessary.

o Notify relevant departments or personnel about important document updates, changes, or backups completed.

Courier Dispatch

o Manage and oversee the dispatch of all outgoing parcels, documents, and packages.

o Receive incoming parcels, packages, or documents, ensuring accurate logging and delivery to the correct department or recipient.

o Monitor courier costs and manage the budget allocated for courier services.

o Seek the most cost\-effective courier services without compromising on the quality or reliability of delivery.

o Assist in negotiating rates and terms with courier companies when necessary.

o Coordinate with internal teams to ensure proper packaging and documentation for all outgoing shipments.

o Liaise with external courier companies to arrange for timely collection and delivery of items.

title: Power2Her Associate
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

About the Programme


Power2Her is HSBC India Bank’s first\-ever formal returnship programme that enables promising women professionals to return to work after a career break. Launched in 2021, it is a key initiative to augment the potential of women colleagues looking to restart their career. It is also an opportunity to attract great talent and strengthen future leadership pipeline. This is a structured 6\-month journey to build the mindset and skills to integrate back into work. The participants will be entitled to a standard monthly stipend for the duration of the program. Power2Her (P2H) has played a pivotal role in infusing diversity at mid to junior levels within the bank. We have deployed 56% participants into full time roles across businesses and functions.


Who are we looking for?


If you are looking to return back to work and fulfil the criteria below then please apply by clicking the button below and send us your resume. If selected, we will be in contact within the next 2 weeks to confirm your participation and further details. If it is not for you, but you do know someone that could be interested then please do forward this on and ask them to apply!

* Minimum 5 years of professional full\-time experience
* Out of the workforce for a minimum of 6 months
* Open to opportunities for 6 months’ contract roles based in India
* Previous career history in one of the following areas: Wealth Management, Relationship Management, Service Orientation, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Business Banking, Trade Finance, Cash Management, Securities Services, Custody, Asset Management Sales/Service/Operations, Data Analytics, Compliance, Risk Management, Operations, Finance \& Accounting, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Business Support, Supply Chain and Procurement
* Eligible to work in India
* Must be available to attend all workshops and events related to the program


How will we support the returners?

* A well\-rounded 6 months Development Plan with structured interventions has been carefully designed to support the transition of returning candidates.
* The returners will be invited to join two curated workshops on ‘Reboot your Career \& Personal Brand’ and ‘Communicate with Confidence \& Empowered Accountability’ to support assimilate into our culture and be provided with a mentor to help navigate the eco\-system better.
* A sensitization workshop for Line Managers is organized to help create awareness on their role and aspired behaviors when managing this group.

  

Programme Features:

* P2H returners are hired across organization levels and do not have a Global Career Band
* P2H returners are hired basis business demand throughout the year
* P2H returners are entitled to 10 days Privilege Leaves that should be pre\-approved on email by the Line Manager during the 6\-month internship duration
* P2H returners are entitled to the Child\-care allowance as per policy (where required)
* P2H returners are encouraged to apply on all internal \& external jobs that are advertised basis relevance of skills from the day of joining
* P2H returners can be converted for a Full Time role on a real time basis if the returner has performed well and shows potential as per business hiring needs


Application \& Selection process for the Power2Her programme:

* To apply for the programme, please visit our website and apply
* Submit your profile by completing 7 self\-explanatory steps. Once the profile submission and e\-signature step is completed. A link to complete the psychometric assessment will appear. Please take your time to complete the assessment
* Profiles of candidates who have cleared the assessment will be shared with Hiring Managers for further evaluation
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews with respective business manager \& HR
* Pre\-Employment Vetting (PEV) checks will be initiated for the final selected candidate
* Employment contract for 6 months will be issued to the candidate with start \& end date post PEV checks completion which take about 2 weeks
* Induction invite will be sent with more details with the date of joining
* Experience Letter will be issued post 6 months’ program completion


Selection for Full time opportunities


Returners will be evaluated during the 6 months’ tenor. They will be evaluated for full\-time opportunities subject to performance and availability of suitable openings across businesses and functions. For more details on the programme, please reach out to rachna1\.mathur@hsbc.co.in


Reference Links


Testimonial Video Link: https://social.global.hsbc/umatube/videos/10673399

 **Additional Information**

 *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:

* Manage end\-to\-end background verification process for hires across UK, Europe, Middle East, APAC, LATAM, and other ROW countries.
* Initiate and track verification requests through screening vendors and internal systems.
* Review completed background reports for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

description:
**Job Description** **HR AI Solutions Architect, Mumbai**


The HR AI Solution Architect is the senior technical leader responsible for turning NIQ’s HR AI vision into practical, enterprise\-ready solutions: from one intelligent front door for HR, to agentic experiences that can complete work on behalf of employees and managers, to predictive insights that support earlier, better decisions. Working at the intersection of HR and technology, this role turns strategic priorities into secure, scalable AI capabilities.  

This is a pivotal role in the next phase of HR transformation. It combines architecture leadership with hands\-on delivery: shaping the technical approach, guiding key design decisions, and personally driving priority builds. As a senior individual contributor, the role works across HR, Tech, Security, Legal, and vendors to ensure HR AI solutions are well designed, governed, and built in a way that improves experience and drives efficiency.

**Responsibilities:**

* Translate the HR AI product vision into technical architecture and solution designs.
* Lead architecture workshops and solution reviews for priority HR AI use cases, using a product mindset to ensure solutions solve real user needs and meet enterprise requirements.
* Define how HR AI solutions connect to HR systems and data, and set the technical guardrails so they are secure, reliable, and aligned with responsible AI expectations.
* Act as the connector across HR, Tech, Security, Legal, platform teams, and external vendors so decisions are aligned and work moves forward efficiently.
* If we build, directly design and build agents in Copilot/Foundry for the most complex or high\-value solutions, while supporting other HR builders in their own builds; if needed, oversee technical delivery for more complex code\-based solutions.
* If we buy, partner closely with the vendor solution architect on setup, integration, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Monitor usage, performance, and improvement opportunities across the HR AI solution, partnering with the HR AI Product Leader on adoption and feedback.
* Create playbooks and technical guidance so HR teams can build and manage AI solutions more effectively.
* Support HR builders using no\-code and low\-code tools, helping them strengthen their solutions while staying within clear guardrails.
* Bring together HR builders as a community of practice so they can share their experiences and learn faster.
* Troubleshoot HR\-owned AI solutions and help teams improve quality, usability, and business impact over time.  

  

**Partnership with the HR AI Product Leader**
* The HR AI Product Leader would own the product lens: defining the experience vision, prioritizing use cases, sequencing work, aligning decisions to HR strategy and enterprise value, and owning the communication strategy so the experience feels cohesive across HR. The HR AI Solution Architect would partner alongside this role to turn that vision into the actual solution: determining the right architecture, build\-vs\-buy approach, and technical decisions for each use case. Working in partnership with HR and Tech, the role would ensure solutions can be built, integrated, governed, and scaled effectively.

 **Qualifications**  

* Significant hands\-on experience building and deploying enterprise AI, automation, or agent\-based solutions: ideally including Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar platforms.
* Strong solution architecture and integration experience across enterprise systems, APIs, data, security, and workflow design.
* Experience translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions that can move from concept to production.
* Experience working in HR technology domains or similarly complex enterprise workflows where policy, data sensitivity, and user experience matter.
* Strong judgment on build\-vs\-buy decisions, including experience working with external vendors and solution architects.
* Experience setting guardrails for security, privacy, responsible AI, reliability, and observability in an enterprise environment.
* Ability to operate as a senior individual contributor who can both design the approach and personally drive delivery on the highest\-priority solutions.

The **Security Officer** acts as the operational lead at the site level, responsible for implementing security procedures, supervising guard personnel, coordinating with clients, and ensuring all security and safety standards are consistently met. This is a critical leadership role that bridges field operations and client expectations.

  



### **Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Site Command and Control:**

* Ensure guards follow all post duties, site\-specific instructions (SSIs), and G4S protocols.
  



**2\. Team Supervision:**

**3\. Client Coordination:**

**4\. Operational Execution:**

* Supervise material movement, vehicle access, and contractor/staff entry protocols.
  



**5\. Incident Management:**

* Guide guards during emergencies and implement evacuation protocols as needed.
  


* File detailed incident and investigation reports with photographic/log support.
  



**6\. Documentation \& Reporting:**


* Maintain daily shift logs, occurrence reports, visitor data, and material movement records.
  


* Prepare and submit weekly performance summaries and manpower deployment reports.
  


* Ensure all statutory registers (muster rolls, PF, ESI) are updated and audit\-ready.
  



**7\. Training \& Compliance:**


* Conduct on\-the\-job training, drills, and refreshers for site guards.
  


* Ensure adherence to G4S grooming, behavior, and discipline standards.

* **Physical Standards:** Fit and alert; Minimum height 170 cm.

* Strong leadership and coordination skills.

* Knowledge of safety procedures, emergency protocols, and fire prevention.

description:
About us: Ritzz Continental Corner is a heritage Indian mithai and food brand from Lucknow with three retail outlets, and expanding, an in‑house bakery, fast‑food , multicusine \& chaat counters, catering services, namkeen production and a factory unit. We’re growing rapidly and seek an experienced Accounts Manager to own finance \& accounting operations across retail, catering and factory channels.

Short Job Summary (Indeed\-friendly)  
We’re hiring an Accounts Manager to manage end‑to‑end accounting, reporting, compliance and finance processes for our multi‑unit F\&B and manufacturing business. The ideal candidate will have strong bookkeeping and MIS skills, experience with multi‑outlet retail and production accounting, knowledge of GST/FSSAI\-related invoicing and statutory compliance, and the ability to implement controls and streamline processes in a fast‑paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee full\-cycle accounting: journal entries, ledgers, reconciliations, bank \& cash management, AR/AP and payroll coordination.
* Prepare monthly/quarterly financial statements, P\&L, balance sheet and cash‑flow reports; produce timely MIS for the GM and ownership.
* Manage outlet \& factory daily sales reconciliation, POS batching, cash collection controls, and inter\-branch accounting.
* Supervise vendor invoicing, purchase order matching, timely payments and vendor reconciliations; negotiate payment terms where appropriate.
* Handle payroll processing, statutory deductions, PF/ESI filings and employer compliance coordination with HR.
* Ensure timely GST invoicing, returns (GSTR) preparation and filing coordination with tax consultant; maintain GST records for inputs, credit and e‑invoices where applicable.
* Maintain and manage inventory accounting (raw materials, WIP, finished goods), stock valuations, cost of goods sold calculations and periodic physical stock audits.
* Implement and maintain internal controls, SOPs for cash handling, expense approvals and vendor onboarding to reduce leakage and improve auditability.
* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits and management/board reviews; work with external CA/audit teams to provide schedules and clarifications.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis; drive cost\-control initiatives for food cost, wastage and overheads.
* Implement or manage ERP/POS/accounting software usage and train relevant staff on accurate data capture.

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* CA Inter / B.Com with 4–8 years’ experience in accounting \& finance; CA qualified or part‑qualified is a plus.
* Minimum 2–3 years experience with multi‑outlet retail, F\&B or food manufacturing accounting preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF/ESI, and statutory compliance for MSME/manufacturing entities.
* Hands‑on experience with Tally / Busy / Zoho Books / QuickBooks or similar accounting software; experience with POS/ERP integrations preferred.
* Proficient in advanced Excel (pivot tables, vlookups, formulas) and comfortable building MIS dashboards.
* High attention to detail, strong organizational skills and ability to meet tight deadlines.

Core Competencies

* Strong numerical \& analytical skills; process‑oriented and controls\-driven.
* Good communication and stakeholder\-management (vendors, internal teams, auditors).
* Integrity, confidentiality and ethical handling of financial data.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-location business and prioritize tasks.

● Conduct regular review meetings to assess customer satisfaction, gather feedback and explore partnership expansion.

● Proactively identify and pursue new business within existing accounts and new corporate prospects.

● Introduce Company’s range of services—from printed marketing collateral to corporate gifting and stationery—to decision\-makers.

● Create and deliver well\-structured, customized proposals that address each client’s specific needs.

**Sales Execution \& Target Achievement** 

● Drive the complete sales cycle—from lead generation and quoting to negotiation and closing—focusing on meeting and exceeding sales targets.

● Strategize pricing, terms, and service packages to optimize deal value for both the client and the Company.

● Maintain and expand the sales funnel to ensure healthy revenue growth.

**Customer Experience \& Service Excellence** 

● Ensure a smooth client journey by strictly adhering to operational processes and customer service standards.

● Act quickly to resolve any issues, keeping clients satisfied and reinforcing Company’s reliability.

● Maintain detailed account records, communications, and follow\-ups in CRM systems. 5\. Cross\-functional Collaboration

● Work closely with internal teams—production, operations, design, logistics—to ensure deliverables match client expectations.

● Advocate for clients internally, pushing for enhancements in Company’s offerings and processes to improve long\-term satisfaction. Key Skills and Qualifications

● Experience: 3 \- 5\+ years in B2B or corporate sales with a proven track record in managing key accounts and closing large deals.

● **Industry Fit**: Should have sold to HR/Marketing/Procurement/Admin heads in previous roles. Prior experience in printing, gifting, merchandising product sales or B2B SaaS sales is also a strong advantage.

● Education: Bachelor’s required; MBA or relevant post‑graduate qualification preferred.

**Core Skills**:

Communication—spoken and written—with the ability to present professionally and persuasively. ○ Excellent personal etiquette and stakeholder management. ○ Structured, process\-oriented mindset with strong organizational and prioritization skills. ○ Strategic sales acumen: funnel building, negotiation, and opportunity mapping. ○ Resourcefulness, ownership, and effective problem\-solving in demanding situations. ○ Comfort navigating complex sales with multiple decision\-makers and long sales cycles.

● We offer high\-quality customized print and corporate gifting solutions to blue\-chip clients like Google, Accenture and PhonePe.

● Work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment where you'll get exposure to sales, operations, marketing, and printing technology.

● Contribute to Company’s mission: making print ordering “easy” and putting smiles on customers’ faces at scale.

● Enjoy robust career growth opportunities with an organization on a rapid expansion trajectory.

**Company Description** 
 Cellumantra Biorefinery Pvt. Ltd. is a DPIIT\-recognized green biotechnology startup developing an enzymatic biorefinery platform to convert non\-wood agricultural waste into industrial enzymes and advanced biomaterials. The company focuses on revenue\-first enzyme production for sectors such as textiles and wastewater treatment, followed by high\-margin cellulose nanofibers (CNF) for sustainable materials. Its technology is optimized for Indian biomass, enabling cost\-efficient, scalable, and circular manufacturing. By valorizing agricultural residues, Cellumantra helps reduce farm\-waste burning and dependence on imported enzymes and materials, creating climate\-positive industrial solutions. The team aims to combine deep\-tech innovation with commercially viable, impact\-oriented business models.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, remote Co\-founder role for Startup Fundraising Experts with Investments at Cellumantra Biorefinery Pvt. Ltd. The co\-founder will lead fundraising strategy and execution, including identifying and qualifying potential investors, preparing pitch decks and financial models, and managing investor outreach and follow\-ups. Day\-to\-day tasks include developing and refining the funding roadmap (pre\-seed, seed, and growth stages), coordinating due diligence, and negotiating term sheets and investment structures in collaboration with existing founders. The role involves building and maintaining relationships with angels, family offices, VC funds, strategic partners, and grant\-making bodies, while representing the startup at events, demo days, and industry forums. The co\-founder will also contribute to overall business strategy, support revenue\-generating partnerships, and invest capital in line with agreed milestones and governance practices.

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills, including financial modeling, valuation analysis, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear investor\-facing storytelling, presentation skills, and professional writing.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Marketing skills to craft compelling pitches, position the startup to different investor segments, and support go\-to\-market efforts.
* Candidates should possess solid Research abilities to map investor ecosystems, track funding trends, and identify relevant grants and strategic partners.
* Prior experience in startup fundraising (angel, VC, grants, or corporate partnerships), preferably in deep\-tech, climate tech, or biotech.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote, fast\-paced startup environment and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.

title: AI Strategies Implementation Technical Manager
description:
Hiring AI Strategies Implementation Technical Manager
 



 Experience: 14 to 20 Years
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Notice: 0 to 30 days
 



  





**Strategy \& solution design** 




 Translates business problems into feasible AI/ML solutions; evaluates build\-vs\-buy vs. fine\-tune decisions; selects appropriate models, frameworks, and platforms (LLMs, traditional ML, computer vision, etc.) based on use case, cost, and latency needs; defines technical roadmaps for AI adoption across the organization.
 



**Implementation \& delivery management** 




 Leads end\-to\-end delivery of AI projects from pilot to production; manages scope, timelines, and resourcing across data science, engineering, and product teams; runs agile/iterative delivery cycles suited to the experimental nature of AI work; de\-risks projects by sequencing quick wins ahead of harder bets.
 



**Technical architecture oversight** 




 Ensures solutions are designed for scalability, maintainability, and integration with existing systems; oversees MLOps/LLMOps pipelines data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring; reviews architecture decisions around vector databases, RAG pipelines, model hosting (cloud vs. on\-prem), and API integrations.
 



**Data governance \& quality** 




 Ensures data pipelines feeding models are reliable, well\-governed, and compliant; partners with data engineering on data quality, lineage, and access controls; addresses bias, fairness, and representativeness in training data.
 



**Model evaluation \& risk management** 




 Establishes evaluation frameworks for accuracy, hallucination rates, and business KPIs; manages AI\-specific risks model drift, bias, security (prompt injection, data leakage), and explainability; ensures compliance with emerging AI regulations and internal responsible\-AI policies; sets up human\-in\-the\-loop review where needed.
 



**Vendor \& tooling management** 




 Evaluates and manages relationships with AI vendors and platform providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, etc.); negotiates SLAs, cost structures, and data privacy terms; benchmarks tools against internal needs.
 



**Cross\-functional stakeholder management** 




 Acts as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership; translates technical constraints and capabilities into business language; manages expectations around what AI can and cannot realistically do; drives change management and user adoption.
 



**Team leadership** 




 Manages or coordinates data scientists, ML engineers, and AI engineers; mentors team members on best practices; fosters a culture of experimentation balanced with production discipline; conducts performance reviews and skill development planning.
 



**Monitoring \& continuous improvement** 




 Sets up post\-deployment monitoring for model performance, cost, and drift; runs feedback loops to retrain/improve models; tracks ROI and business impact of deployed AI systems; iterates based on user feedback and changing data patterns.
 



**Security \& compliance** 




 Ensures AI systems meet data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, or sector\-specific rules); implements guardrails against misuse, prompt injection, and unauthorized data exposure; particularly relevant given defense/public\-sector context (Cubic), ensures alignment with frameworks like NIST AI RMF or DoD AI ethics principles.

 Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all.
 **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world\-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.**

 With programs like

Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

This position develops and maintains performance reporting, dashboards, and analytical solutions that provide organizational leaders with meaningful visibility into key performance indicators, operational trends, and business outcomes. The Senior Enterprise Performance Analyst collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to identify reporting needs, transform data into actionable insights, and support continuous improvement initiatives. This role also provides technical guidance and mentorship to junior analysts, promotes data quality and analytical best practices, and contributes to the ongoing advancement of enterprise performance measurement and reporting capabilities.

* Work with leaders across the value chain to gather the necessary information to track organizational performance with the aim of addressing cross\-functional improvement opportunities
* Assist in formulating proper indicators across departments and lead team effort to produce data that will shed light on indicators, to understand execution performance, strengths and opportunities
* Provide business support to operations team as needed and interface with strategic customers when required

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Senior Data Operations Analyst
description:
**Job Description** **Job Description**


The Senior Data Operations Analyst acts as a point of contact between Operations and internal client services/clients to manage end\-to\-end (E2E) operational queries and provide client support. The role also serves as a secondary point of contact in the absence of the Associate Manager, handling E2E operational queries and deliverables.


The analyst is responsible for delivering databases and outputs based on client specifications, ensuring timely delivery with high\-quality standards, and actively engaging with stakeholders. The role requires foundational experience in logical thinking and analytical research domains. Additionally, the role requires independent ownership of regular BAU (Business\-as\-Usual) activities, ensuring seamless execution without operational dependencies.

**Responsibilities**

* **SQL Data Management:** Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries to retrieve datasets and tables from SQL databases.
* **Data Analytics:** Perform in\-depth analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
* **Data Quality Assurance:** Monitor, validate, and improve data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across systems.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify opportunities to automate workflows and enhance efficiency in data operations.
* Demonstrate strong analytical thinking by solving complex problems with innovative, out\-of\-the\-box solutions.
* Execute defined reports, schedules, and processes by adhering to procedures, delivery schedules, and SLAs.
* Independently manage and deliver regular BAU activities end\-to\-end, ensuring minimal or no dependency on others.
* Maintain SOP documents and ensure that checklists and trackers are updated regularly.
* Provide constructive input to Process Owners, Team Leads, and the Operations Manager to improve operational effectiveness.
* Understand the relationship between assigned processes and upstream/downstream dependencies to ensure clean data delivery and minimize rework across Operations teams.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3\+ years of overall experience.
* **SQL Expertise:** At least 2 years of hands\-on experience in SQL, including query optimization and handling large datasets.
* **Educational Background:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
* **Analytics Experience:** Strong background in data analytics, statistical modeling, or banking/financial services.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work collaboratively and meet deadlines.
* High level of accuracy, proactiveness, and attention to detail.
* Project management aptitude (critical path management, task sequencing, problem\-solving, etc.).
* Proficiency in business English (both spoken and written).

title: HR Manager
description:
HR Manager

**Company:** Aspireon Ventures  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Department:** Human Resources

About Aspireon Ventures

Aspireon Ventures is a growing multi\-vertical organization operating across **education, film \& media, creative services, content, and emerging business ventures**. As we scale our businesses and teams, we are looking for an experienced and hands\-on **HR Manager** who can build strong people systems, culture, and processes from the ground up.

Role Overview

We are looking for an **HR Manager who can build, manage, and scale the entire HR function of a growing organization**.

This is not a conventional HR administration role. The ideal candidate should be capable of taking ownership of HR operations end\-to\-end—from **manpower planning and talent acquisition to payroll, performance management, policies, employee engagement, compliance, and organizational development**.

You will work closely with the management team to build a high\-performance organization with the right people, processes, culture, and systems in place.

Key Responsibilities1\. HR Strategy \& Organizational Development

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with Aspireon Ventures' business goals.
* Build HR systems and processes suitable for a growing multi\-vertical organization.
* Develop organizational structures, reporting frameworks, job roles, and HR workflows.
* Work closely with management on manpower planning and workforce requirements.
* Support the organization in building a strong and performance\-driven culture.

2\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle from identifying manpower requirements to onboarding.
* Develop effective recruitment strategies for creative, academic, corporate, sales, media, and operational roles.
* Create and optimize Job Descriptions and hiring processes.
* Source candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, recruitment platforms, referrals, and other channels.
* Conduct initial screening and coordinate interviews with department heads and management.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future requirements.
* Reduce hiring turnaround time while maintaining quality of recruitment.

3\. Payroll \& Compensation

* Manage monthly payroll processes and ensure accurate and timely salary processing.
* Maintain employee salary structures, incentives, deductions, attendance, leave, and payroll records.
* Coordinate with accounts/finance teams for payroll\-related activities.
* Assist management in developing compensation structures and employee benefits.

4\. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop, implement, and maintain company HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure proper documentation of employment\-related processes.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Establish proper processes for attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, resignation, and full \& final settlement.

5\. Performance Management

* Design and implement employee performance evaluation systems.
* Establish KRAs/KPIs in coordination with department heads.
* Manage probation, confirmation, performance reviews, promotions, and increments.
* Identify performance gaps and coordinate improvement plans.
* Help build a culture of accountability and measurable performance.

6\. Employee Engagement \& Culture

* Build a positive, professional, and collaborative workplace culture.
* Develop employee engagement initiatives and internal communication systems.
* Address employee concerns and grievances professionally.
* Improve employee retention and overall employee experience.
* Act as a trusted bridge between management and employees.

7\. Learning \& Development

* Identify training and development requirements across departments.
* Coordinate internal and external training programs.
* Develop employee development plans based on organizational requirements.
* Support leadership in building future\-ready teams.

8\. HR Operations \& Administration

* Manage onboarding and employee induction processes.
* Maintain accurate employee databases and HR documentation.
* Monitor attendance, leave, working hours, and employee records.
* Manage employee lifecycle processes from joining to exit.
* Prepare regular HR reports and workforce analytics for management.

What We Are Looking For

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **3–6 years of relevant experience in HR**, preferably in a growing company, startup, education, media, creative, or multi\-business environment.
* Strong experience in **end\-to\-end HR management**.
* Proven ability to independently build HR systems and processes.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, payroll, performance management, employee relations, and HR policies.
* Good understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work closely with founders/management and department heads.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in HRMS, MS Office/Google Workspace, and recruitment platforms.

Preferred Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following environments will be preferred:

* Startups or fast\-growing organizations
* Education / EdTech
* Media \& Entertainment
* Creative agencies
* Digital marketing / content companies
* Multi\-location organizations
* Organizations undergoing rapid team expansion

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* **Thinks beyond traditional HR.**
* Can build HR systems from scratch.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and evolving organization.
* Can independently handle both strategic HR and day\-to\-day HR operations.
* Understands how to hire and retain creative, academic, technical, and corporate talent.
* Has strong ownership and accountability.
* Can balance employee needs with organizational objectives.
* Is proactive, approachable, and solution\-oriented.
* Is capable of building an HR department that can scale with the organization.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

The HR Manager will be evaluated on:

* Quality and speed of recruitment
* Employee retention
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Payroll accuracy and timeliness
* HR process implementation
* Employee engagement
* Performance management effectiveness
* Compliance and documentation
* Employee satisfaction
* Training and development initiatives
* Overall HR system maturity and scalability

Why Join Aspireon Ventures?

* Opportunity to **build and lead the HR function of a growing organization**.
* Work across multiple business verticals including education, media, creative, and emerging ventures.
* Direct interaction with management and leadership.
* Opportunity to create systems and processes rather than simply follow existing ones.
* Growth\-oriented and dynamic work environment.
* Opportunity to shape organizational culture and build high\-performing teams.

**If you are an HR professional who enjoys building organizations, developing people, and creating systems from the ground up, we would love to hear from you.**

**Apply now and be part of Aspireon Ventures' growth journey.**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you available to join with us immediately?

Work Location: In person

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks

company: kinemach engineering and machines pvt ltd
description:
About Kinemach

Kinemach is a manufacturing technology and solutions company based in Pune, designing and building assembly automation lines, material handling and robotics systems, processing equipment, packaging machinery, and inspection/testing systems for customers across automotive, pharmaceutical, food processing, electronics, and rubber/plastics industries. Our product portfolio includes two specialised brands: Procer Mixing, which manufactures high\-shear mixers, homogenizers, and turnkey process plants for the food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries, built to GMP and precision rotor\-stator tolerances; and DynaScrew, which manufactures precision automatic screw\-feeding and driving systems used in automotive, electronics, aerospace, and medical\-device assembly.

Because our machines are custom\-engineered, precision\-built, and shipped to customers who expect documented, repeatable quality, QA/QC is central to how we deliver \- from the raw material and bought\-out components that come in, through machining and assembly, to the functional testing and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) before a machine leaves our facility.

Role Summary

We are looking for a QA/QC Engineer to own quality checks across all three product lines \- Kinemach's automation and assembly systems, Procer's mixing and homogenizing equipment, and DynaScrew's screw\-feeding and driving systems. This is a hands\-on, shop\-floor role: you will inspect incoming materials and components, verify in\-process machining and assembly against engineering drawings, run functional and calibration checks on finished sub\-assemblies and machines, and maintain the inspection records and documentation our customers and quality systems require.

Key Responsibilities

\- Perform incoming quality inspection of raw materials, castings, and bought\-out components (motors, sensors, PLCs, pneumatics, fasteners) against purchase specifications and drawings.

\- Carry out in\-process dimensional inspection during machining and fabrication using standard measuring instruments (verniers, micrometers, dial/height gauges); read and verify parts against engineering drawings and GD\&T callouts.

\- Conduct functional and calibration testing on assembled sub\-systems \- for example torque verification and screw\-feed accuracy on DynaScrew stations, and rotor\-stator clearance, leak, and CIP/SIP checks on Procer mixing equipment.

\- Support final inspection and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of completed machines prior to dispatch, including preparing FAT checklists and test records for customer sign\-off.

\- Raise, document, and track Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs); coordinate with production, design, and vendors on root cause and corrective actions.

\- Maintain calibration schedules and records for measuring and test instruments, and ensure traceability of inspection data.

\- Prepare and maintain quality documentation \- inspection reports, quality plans, test certificates \- in line with ISO 9001 requirements, and GMP\-related documentation for Procer's pharma/food equipment where applicable.

\- Assist with vendor/supplier quality evaluation and periodic audits of incoming material quality.

\- Flag recurring quality issues on the shop floor and support continuous improvement in inspection methods and process controls.

Requirements

\- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, or Mechatronics Engineering (or equivalent).

\- 0\-3 years of experience in a QA/QC, quality inspection, or manufacturing quality role \- freshers with strong fundamentals and internship/project exposure to inspection are welcome to apply.

\- Working knowledge of standard measuring instruments (vernier caliper, micrometer, dial/height gauge); exposure to CMM is a plus.

\- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, including basic GD\&T.

\- Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management concepts and basic documentation practices (inspection reports, NCRs, calibration records).

\- Comfortable working on the shop floor across machining, assembly, and testing areas, not only at a desk.

\- Good communication skills to coordinate with production, design, and vendors; proficiency with MS Office (Excel in particular).

Preferred (Good to Have)

\- Prior exposure to capital equipment, custom machine building, or low\-volume/high\-mix manufacturing rather than mass\-production QA.

\- Familiarity with GMP requirements or quality expectations for pharmaceutical/food processing equipment.

\- Basic exposure to electromechanical or mechatronic system testing (torque tools, sensors, PLC\-driven equipment).

What We Offer

\- Direct, hands\-on exposure to three distinct engineering product lines \- automation, precision mixing/process equipment, and precision fastening systems \- under one roof.

\- Close mentorship from senior engineering and quality teams on custom machine\-building practices not typically seen in mass\-production QA roles.

\- A shop\-floor\-first culture where quality engineers work directly alongside design, machining, and assembly teams.

Location: Pune, Maharashtra (On\-site)

Experience: 0\-3 years

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Education \- MBA in Human Resources (compulsory)**

Location \- Bengaluru

Duration \- 2\-3 months

description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

  

**Job Track Description:*** Performs tasks based on established procedures.
* Uses data organizing and coordination skills to perform business support or technical work.
* Requires vocational training, certifications, licensures, or equivalent experience.

**General Profile*** Proficiency within a range of analytical or operational processes.
* Completes atypical assignments.
* Works within established procedures and practices.
* May establish the appropriate approach for new assignments.
* Acts as a resource for colleagues.
* Completes work with limited supervision.

**Functional Knowledge*** Has developed skills in a range of processes, procedures, and systems.

**Business Expertise*** Understanding of how best teams integrate and work together to achieve company goals.

**Impact*** Impacts a team, by example, through the quality service and information provided
* Uses discretion to change work procedures and practices.

**Leadership*** May provide guidance and support to junior team members.

**Problem Solving*** Provides solutions to atypical problems based on existing precedents or procedures.

**Interpersonal Skills*** Exchanges information and ideas effectively.

**Responsibility Statements*** Prepares benefit calculations and reports. (e.g., accurate payment of vendor monthly billings, employee leave, and terminations)
* Prepares year\-end benefit statements and benefit record updates.
* Assists with benefit open enrollment process including system testing, employee self\-service enrollment and updates.
* Guides employees in the completion of appropriate forms, claims, calculation of benefits, and premiums.
* Liaises with actuarial staff, senior consultants, senior administrators, managers, and trust and insurance company representatives on behalf of client employees.
* Processes relocation documentation and payments. (e.g., extending inbound contracts, visas, and assisting employees with setting up bank accounts)
* Prepares offers, terms, and conditions letters.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.

description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

description:

* Monitor and record all drivers’ punch IN and OUT from biometric / timekeeping systems on a daily basis.
* Verify that each driver is punching as per assigned shift (start time, end time, break time) and highlight deviations.

* Investigate and correct attendance issues such as missed punches, duplicate punches, or system errors after approval from the supervisor.
* Maintain proper records and files (soft copy and hard copy) of attendance, shift rosters, and driver contact details for audit and reference.
* Support management with daily/weekly MIS reports on driver availability, utilization, overtime, and absenteeism.
* Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of all timekeeping data and follow company policies related to attendance and discipline.

title: Operations Manager
description:
An **Operations Manager** in a construction company is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the company’s day\-to\-day construction operations across multiple projects. The role focuses on ensuring projects have the required manpower, materials, machinery, subcontractors, finances, and management support to achieve **time, cost, quality, safety, and productivity targets**.

Key Responsibilities

* **Project Operations \& Execution** – Oversee ongoing construction projects, review work progress, identify delays or operational problems, and coordinate corrective actions with Project Managers and Site Engineers.

Every day, ANDRITZ continues to deliver successful innovative solutions to our customers globally. Why are we so successful? Because we are passionate and love what we do! **JOB DESCRIPTION:** SITE MANAGER \[SR\&LH] for International Project Sites.
  
  

Reporting to
  
  

Functionally to HoD (SI) and operationally to Project team during the execution of the project.
  
  

**Role:**  

The Site Manager is responsible for the Site\-Planning, Erection \& Commissioning activities of Large Hydro Power Plant. He is based at site, leading the Expats, Site supervisors, QC Engineers, Stores team and various contractors for successful execution of Site Works.
  
  

**Main Tasks:**  

Representation of the project at site to the Customer and his International Consultants
  
Site Mobilization and Establishment of Accommodation, infrastructure, offices, and stores etc.
  
Controlling of all installation and commissioning activities in respect of technical performance, quality, cost and time schedule and corrective measures in case of deviations
  
Co\-ordination of site work. Calling of regular site meetings (minutes of meetings required) and reporting to the Project Manager /SI Team Leader.
  
Site management and coordination of site personnel (Expats, supervisor/installation company)
  
Management of health, safety and environmental aspects. As per EHS practices, Stop the process, set off the alarm, protect the workplace, seek help, first aid through safety member. HIRA, POWRA.
  
Preparation of Installation reports, site logbook, weekly / monthly reports, meeting protocols, test protocols, records for claims and control on QC documentation
  
Handling monthly site cash and timely submission of accounts.
  
Procurement of site materials and services in coordination with the project manager (refer signature regulation (P HIN 01 03 01 \-1\)
  
Coordination with home office and on shore manager in respect of local transports (crane availability, storage yard, etc)
  
Allotment of work for site / sub supplier staff \& review the progress.
  
Handling, storage, preservation, administration of tools, materials, limited storable materials, and dangerous substances, prompt checking, marking of the product to prevent unintended use E.g. sticker.
  
Planning and execution of Installation instructions, inspection and test plans, test procedures
  
Compiling NCRs, helping to resolve site non\-conformities and timely reporting to the PM
  
Project specific Health and Safety and Environmental Plan Health and Safety meetings, instructions and toolbox talks, inspections through nominated safety member.
  
Analysis of the reasons for the deviation, accident, or incident. Definition and implementation of preventive measures and instruction of personnel, NCR or accident /incident report.
  
Claim identification form to be issued and sent to the CPM and PM
  
Support during commissioning according to R HY EX60 01 Commissioning report.
  
Final protocol and punch point controlling.
  
Comparison planned vs. actual schedule and costs, nonconformities, accident statistic, environmental incidents, experiences, and improvement potentials for further projects.
  
Input for the final project meeting \& Final report installation.
  
Risk management and mitigation measures
  
Stakeholders’ management
  
Interface management
  
Quality assurance
  
  

**Authorities:**  

Sanction leave of his subordinates at site as per procedure.
  
Release the person from site in consultation with SI (TL) \& PM
  
Site manager can appoint third party for manpower supply in consultation with HR dept. /SI\-TL
  
Administrative work e.g. Site Accommodation, Guest House, Vehicle hire for site works (also visitors), Attendance \& OT Reports.
