title: Proposal Lead /Bid Manager-(Walk In Interview -08-August 2026-Bangalore)
description:
**Overview**
------------


You will be working closely with regional win work/technical leads and business development \& the engagement team across AtkinsRéalis and the wider organisation to produce compelling bids. As a member of the central Bid Management team, you will also be responsible for contributing to the continuous improvement of the win\-work capability (people, processes, tools, information, and governance). You will report to the Proposal Managers (Canada) and Win Work Team lead (GTC)

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead the development and application of proposal/bid themes. Develop organization chart with the pursuit team.
* Coordinate communication between SMEs and proposal writers. Lead teams through strategic reviews as per internal schedule.
* Exercise considerable initiative and independent judgment about content, wording, completeness, correctness, and appropriateness of proposal contents and graphics materials, making recommendations directly to pursuit team.
* Supervise marketing assistants and/or less experienced proposal coordinators. Give work directions to graphic artists and marketing assistants involved in proposal production.
* Experience managing teams to deliver by established deadlines.
* Ensuring that the proposal is run in accordance with best practice and the win work capture plan and pursuit process, and in compliance with the Service Delivery Process.
* Provide client service, commitment, communication, innovation \& continuous improvement, professionalism, quality and teamwork. (Note that "Clients" may be internal managers and staff.)
* Added advantage if you have experience in capture planning
* Implement and facilitate capture planning process
* Facilitate kick off workshops and Go/No Go call
* Facilitate win theme sessions and supporting strategies
* Initiate and drive Go No Go calls and risk cat tool
* Portal Management (CRM tools) and Review procurement documents and attachments.
* Create and maintain a Proposal Management Plan.
* Develop compliance matrix, Storyboard templates and allocate bid deliverables.
* Review / approve response for standard prequalification questions.
* Check PQQ responses from JV partners (if applicable).
* Graphics co\-ordination, (colour schemes; word templates; document covers and dividers; images / photos; graphics / charts / graphs (where applicable) and Graphics approval in accordance with company's Branding Guidelines.
* Work involves knowledgeable application of quality control as well as standard procedures and criteria to the coordination of proposals which are of critical importance to the firm.
* Assist in the development of preparation for Stage\-gate reviews – and facilitate bid go/no\-go decision.
* Support development of CVs.
* Work with the Business Development team to schedule \& co\-ordinate communications activities necessary to identify customer issues, hot buttons and the associated win themes and win strategy statements. Occasionally contact upper management for required signatures.
* Support the production of case studies / evidence scenarios.
* Coordinate with support services (legal, accounting, HR) on administrative sections of the pursuits (e.g., forms, statistics).
* Take constructive feedback and apply it to enhance the delivery.

*Submission*

* Final quality review of documents, post\-formatting and after Bid Coordinator proofread /sense check.
* Final proofread / compliance check of tender documents.
* Close\-out actions with JV partners (if required).
* Client Presentation, Negotiate \& Contract, Feedback, Handover
* Lead, review, approve and disseminate Lessons Learnt feedback – Proposal Lead to lead the session with support from the Bid Co\-ordinator.
* Support response to Client Queries.
* Support preparation for client interviews / presentations.

**About you**
-------------

* Have 5\-10 years (A/E/C industry)
* Have experience leading pursuit responses – the larger and complex ones.
* Understanding of Architectural\-Engineering and project and construction management industry standards and disciplines. Can translate abstract ideas or narrative text into graphical concepts to illustrate concepts more effectively.
* Works independently yet functions effectively as a member of a team.
* Promote and demonstrate team values and behaviours in line with the win work team practices
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Relationship building
* Ability to multi\-task and manage several projects at once
* Attention to detail
* Collaborative approach
* Time management skills
* Enthusiastic, initiative and the confidence to start things from scratch
* Confident using digital tools and learning new ones
* Promote the use of AtkinsRéalis work winning processes and tools
* Instill a culture where others share knowledge, insights and learning

*Specific skills required*

* A strong communicator with strong grammar, spelling, composition, and proofreading abilities.
* Able to evaluate, monitor and present ideas and data.
* Analytical with solid organisational skills, scheduling and prioritising activities.
* A flexible but methodical approach to supporting bids.
* Computer skills required and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, CRM, and other software programmes including LLMs.
* Comfortable and effective when working across all levels of an organisation.
* Makes sound decisions, but also works with other stakeholders (e.g., sales lead, capture lead, PM) to gain buy\-in.

**Rewards \& benefits**
-----------------------


Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.


This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.


Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------


We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

title: Senior Manager - HRBP
description:
**Job Responsibilities** Provide inputs and takes ownership to manage the HR functions (HR Operations, Compensation, Learning and Development, Talent Management, Employer Branding); conceptualizing and implementing programs.

**HR Team and Processes Management**

* Keeps a tab on the feedback of the people by leveraging various sources (HealthCheck, pulse surveys, skips, etc) and drives effective programs that continue to improve engagement and the people experience
* Advises key stakeholders on methods to reinforce and strengthen culture, community and engagement
* Partners with business leaders on issue identification, action planning, and office engagement initiatives
* Participates in and supports recognition programs and communications
* Oversees employee relation issues which may include: performance and discipline, investigations, conflict resolution session(s), and actioning closures.
* Create and Analyze HR metrics time and again to make effective decision
* Drive analytics to provide insights to leadership on the internal/external trends and movements in compensation
* Assist in the performance reviews and annual compensation revision process
* Apply attrition control measures

**People Engagement \& Culture building**

* Drive effective employee engagement initiatives regularly and build powerful connect with the employees
* Liaises across HR teams to support stakeholders with specific issue area (onboarding, orientation, people guidelines, POSH etc)
* Develops and communicates people guidelines, policies and procedures
* Works with other HR team and other corporate function to create and maintain best practices that drive shared outcomes and deliver strong impact/ positive customer experience
* Provides mentorship, coaching and guidance to broader HR team
* Serves as a change management agent/champion

**Performance \& Coaching and Mentoring**

* Provides expertise and partners with the business leaders and performance management team to validate performance information, promotion recommendations and coaching activities
* Supports leadership sessions and communications about performance and promotions
* May lead performance management follow ups for Managers and junior team members
* Is a champion to create a culture of ongoing feedback and high performance
* Works closely with the Business partners to identify training needs and areas for improvement
* Providing direction for setting of KRAs/ Goal Setting to employees and execution of Performance Management system
* Assess training needs to apply and monitor training program

**Good to have Skills**

* Team player, highly responsive and customer focus orientated and strong organizational and planning skills
* Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Solid understanding of HR compliance
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Ability to maintain high level of confidentiality and work with highly sensitive data and information
* Experience working in a fast\-paced and changing environment
* Strong mental agility and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to establish key relationships with business leaders and develop strong credibility

**Qualification and Experience Required**

Masters degree, or equivalent, in a related field (HR, MBA) is preferred. 10\-15 years of experience is preferred, with 10 or 10 plus years in HRBP activities ( Employee Engagement, Employee Relations, Performance Management and HR strategy). Immediate Joiners will be preferred (Night Shift).

Pay: ₹2,000,000\.00 \- ₹2,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst, Credit Analysis & Underwriting - Bangalore
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Summary:**  

Under general supervision (while working independently most of the time), the Senior Analyst – Credit Risk in Wealth Management is responsible for conducting in\-depth credit analysis of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs), privately held businesses, not\-for\-profit organizations, and commercial real estate clients. The Senior Analyst will analyze financial data using tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, assess creditworthiness, and develop credit analysis reports to support underwriting and lending decisions.  

In this role, the Senior Analyst manages complex credit analysis assignments, mentors junior analysts, and ensures the accuracy and quality of credit spreads. The Senior Analyst also works on strategic and special projects identified by management.  

Collaboration with relationship managers and internal stakeholders is required to structure credit facilities that align with clients’ wealth management goals while adhering to Northern Trust’s risk management. This position offers exposure to sophisticated financial products, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities to develop expertise in credit analysis for the wealth management sector.

 **Major Duties:**  

* Analyzes financial statements, credit reports, and economic data to assess the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
* Prepares comprehensive credit reports with a high degree of independence, focusing on operational performance, financial health, and identification of key risk mitigants.
* Monitors borrower performance and ensures timely identification of potential risks by conducting thorough annual reviews.
* Mentors junior analysts to ensure adherence to established standards and guidelines.
* Contributes to division\-wide initiatives and special projects as assigned by management.
* Collaborates with onshore partners and relationship managers to develop tailored credit solutions.
* Ensures adherence to Northern Trust’s credit policies, compliance standards, process\-related guidelines, and controls.
* Consistently adheres to established QUALITY \& QUANTITY SLAs.
* Stays informed about market trends, regulatory changes, and economic factors affecting credit risk.
* Pays attention to detail to ensure all documents are processed correctly.
* Identifies process changes to improve productivity and efficiency.

  

**Qualifications:**  

* Graduation or above degree in finance, accounting, or business administration (or equivalent)
* Additional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CMA, etc., are considered advantageous but are not mandatory.
**Experience \& Skills:**  

* 2 \- 4 years of experience in financial spreading and credit memo underwriting, strong financial analysis and analytical skills. Familiarity with lending products such as lines of credit and term loans is required.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and handle competing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner, effectively telling the story behind financials in a compelling way.
* Ability to research issues/problems and provide a ‘solution\-based’ approach
* Excellent verbal and written communication and partnering skills. A confident and personable attitude with the ability to communicate effectively with onshore relationship managers and other stakeholders
* Self\-motivated individual to go beyond immediate responsibilities
* Familiarity with Moody’s Credit Lens or similar credit spreading tools. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word and other Microsoft 365 tools.
* Capability to coach and mentor junior team members.
 **Shift Coverage:** EMEA \- 12:30PM to 9:30PM IST

 **About the Team**  

This position is within the Financial Risk Division, organizationally aligned under Global Risk. The department plays a pivotal role in the credit underwriting process, monitoring loans, assessing risks across credit portfolios thereby safeguarding the organization’s financial stability by ensuring rigorous credit analysis, adherence to regulatory standards, and the implementation of robust risk mitigation strategies. Through its oversight and expertise, the Financial Risk Division contributes significantly to the institution’s overall risk management framework, supporting prudent lending decisions and promoting long\-term organizational resilience.  

The Credit Services division serves the Northern Trust Wealth Management customers including Global Family Office clients through a range of lending services, including but not limited to Secured, Unsecured loans to Individuals, and their privately held entities, and Commercial Real estate lending.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Senior Manager – Labour Compliance & Governance
description:
India's labour law landscape is undergoing its most significant transformation in decades. The consolidation of over 40 central statutes into four Labour Codes is reshaping how enterprises manage workforce compliance — and GE Vernova needs a senior leader who can build the frameworks to get it right.
  

As the Labour Compliance Leader, you will own enterprise\-wide implementation of the four Labour Codes across a complex, multi\-site organization spanning corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites across India. You will design the governance infrastructure, lead the audits, shape the policies, and be the authoritative voice that helps business and HR leaders navigate India's evolving statutory landscape with confidence.
  

This is a high\-impact senior role for someone who brings deep expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
**Job Description**
===================


**What You'll Do**


* **Lead enterprise Labour Code implementation** — own compliance readiness across all business units, establish governance controls and monitoring frameworks, drive closure of implementation gaps through structured action plans, and advance the digitization of labour compliance processes.
* **Own the compliance calendar and audit function** — develop and manage the statutory filings, returns, renewals, and amendment schedule; lead labour audits; coordinate with labour inspectors, auditors, and government authorities; and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.
* **Govern contractor and vendor compliance** — oversee the statutory compliance of manpower contractors and vendors across factories and project sites, conduct periodic audits, and enforce corrective actions where required.
* **Support labour and employee relations** — liaise with Office Labour Governance, People Operations, Project Site Managers, and Factory Labour Relations teams; support resolution of labour disputes and inspections; and represent the organization in labour hearings, conciliation proceedings, and government inspections.
* **Design and standardize compliance policy** — develop labour compliance Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and frameworks; standardize processes across all operating environments; and serve as a subject matter expert for leadership decision\-making on compliance matters.
* **Enable capability across the organization** — conduct regular training for HR professionals, site leaders, factory managers, and contractors on applicable labour laws, new Labour Codes, and compliance obligations.

**Who You Are**


You are a seasoned labour law and compliance professional with deep knowledge of India's Central and State statutory frameworks, and hands\-on experience operating across multi\-site, complex industrial environments.


**Required**


* A formal education and subsequent Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law (LLB), Human Resources (HR), Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in labour law compliance, industrial relations, and statutory compliance within manufacturing, infrastructure, engineering, construction, or project\-based organizations.
* Proven track record implementing and managing compliance under Central and State Labour Laws, including the new Labour Codes.
* Hands\-on experience managing compliance across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites.
* Demonstrated experience handling labour inspections, statutory audits, government authorities, and legal proceedings.
* Solid experience in contractor and vendor compliance management.
* Strong working knowledge of the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, Factories Act, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Occupational Safety Health and Working Conditions (OSHWC) Code, and Wage Code.
* Familiarity with compliance management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), and standard productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office).

**Preferred**


* Master's degree in HR, Industrial Relations, Labour Welfare (MLW), Personnel Management, or an MBA in HR.
* Professional certifications in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, Compliance Management, or Occupational Health and Safety.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Analyst, HR Support Operations
description:
**Job Description :**


**Senior Analyst, HR Support Operations**


**About News Corp:**


News Corp is a global, diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content to consumers throughout the world. The Company comprises leading businesses across a range of media, including news and information services, subscription video services in Australia, book publishing, and digital real estate services. Distributed under some of the world’s most recognizable brands—including The Wall Street Journal, Dow Jones, The Australian, HarperCollins Publishers, and realtor.com—our commitment to premium content makes our properties a premier destination for news, information, and entertainment across traditional and digital platforms.


**What You’ll Do:**


As a Senior Analyst, you will serve as the central coordinator for the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, managing the operational logistics of onboarding, offboarding, and global mobility for diverse business units. Navigating a complex tech stack, including Workday and ServiceNow, you will maintain data integrity, resolve policy inquiries, and ensure the accurate execution of system transactions. Acting as a primary point of contact for employees and vendors, you will balance high\-volume task management with strict documentation and reporting standards to ensure audit compliance and meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Global Stakeholder Management:** Provide cross\-business unit, global coverage for six business units across six countries.
* **Employee Lifecycle Orchestration:** Act as the single point of contact to coordinate and manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle events—from onboarding to offboarding—with a dedicated focus on a positive employee experience.
* **HR Tech \& Vendor Integration:** Navigate and manage workflows within a diverse global tech stack (including Workday and ServiceNow) while collaborating with specialist vendors such as Tax Advisory, Background Checking, local Benefits, Immigration and others.
* **Policy Guidance \& Support:** Resolve HR\-related queries and provide expert guidance to workers on company policies, system transactions, and the promotion of self\-service tools to improve efficiency.
* **Global Mobility Administration:** Provide oversight and end\-to\-end administration of global mobility cases, ensuring seamless cross\-business unit and vendor collaboration.
* **Data Integrity \& Compliance:** Follow established processes to ensure data accuracy and perform regular audits to meet strict internal, external, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* **Audit Execution:** Facilitate internal and external audit cycles by providing requested reports, conducting sample testing, and delivering evidence to validate process compliance.
* **SLA \& Performance Excellence:** Manage individual workload to deliver high\-quality results in line with predetermined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* **System \& Process Optimization:** Partner with the HR Systems and Solutions Team to identify issues and recommend enhancements that improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the overall HR function.
* **Documentation \& Workflow:** Maintain clear documentation for system workflows and lifecycle events to ensure consistency and audit readiness across the organization.
* **Project Leadership:** Lead and execute ad\-hoc HR operations projects, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive strategic outcomes.
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for HR operations, continuously building deep domain knowledge to provide authoritative guidance and maintain operational excellence.

**Qualifications:**


**Critical Thinking \& Analysis**


* **Systems Impact Awareness:** Proven capacity to foresee and assess how HRIS changes and updates affect interconnected platforms.
* **Operational Foresight:** Robust capability to evaluate the wider effects of operational processes, protecting the consistency and robustness of data down the line.
* **Integrated Problem Solving:** Skilled at investigating the comprehensive effects of system practices, proactively addressing and neutralizing potential integration errors.
* **Analytical Precision:** Strong talent for grasping intricate system configurations and the secondary effects of HR management on company procedures.

**Education \& Experience**


* Possesses a Master’s degree or equivalent professional background in a relevant field.
* 6 to 8 years of progressive experience in HR Operations.

**Technical Proficiency**


* Extensive experience utilizing modern HRIS solutions, specifically Workday and ServiceNow.
* Proficiency in managing complex system workflows and maintaining data integrity across integrated platforms.

**Soft Skills \& Operational Agility**


* Exceptional written and verbal interpersonal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Proven client support capabilities, including active listening and the ability to interpret and fulfill client requirements.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks effectively and escalate complex matters for validation when appropriate.
* Operational agility to support global business processes across multiple time zones (UK, AUS, and US).

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic.


**Reasonable Accommodation**


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com . Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.


Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

The company comprises businesses across a range of media, including: information services and news, digital real estate services and book publishing. description:
**Company Overview:**

**IITIL (Innovative Information Technologies India Limited)** is a forward\-thinking data intelligence and technology company that helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data assets. With deep expertise in analytics, engineering, and enterprise technology, IITIL bridges the gap between complex data environments and clear business outcomes. We focus on understanding each client’s business challenges before recommending tailored data strategies and technology solutions, collaborating across disciplines to design practical, scalable approaches that turn data into actionable insight for decision\-makers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, structured, and detail\-oriented **HR Executive** with 2 to 5 years of core HR operations, compliance, and process design experience. In this remote role, you will play a key role in creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), driving organizational compliance, building HR dashboards, and handling employee grievances and escalations with high confidentiality and empathy. Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and strong analytical reporting skills are essential.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* SOP Creation \& Process Standardization: Draft, implement, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all HR functions to ensure operational consistency across the employee lifecycle.
* Policy Framing \& Implementation: Assist in designing, reviewing, and updating HR policies, employee handbooks, and workplace guidelines in alignment with company objectives and legal standards.
* Statutory \& Labour Compliance: Ensure full compliance with statutory laws (PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, Bonus, LWF, POSH, etc.), maintain accurate documentation, and manage audits.
* Grievance \& Escalation Handling: Serve as the primary contact for employee concerns, conducting fair investigations, resolving conflicts, and managing escalated issues with discretion.
* HR Dashboards \& Advanced Excel Reporting: Build and maintain interactive HR dashboards, MIS reports, attrition tracking, and workforce analytics using Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Data Validation).
* Payroll \& HR Operations Support: Process payroll inputs, verify manual payroll calculations, oversee attendance and leave tracking, and maintain updated employee files.
* Employee Lifecycle Management: Facilitate smooth virtual onboarding, conduct exit interviews, manage offboarding processes, and support employee engagement initiatives.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Experience: 2 to 5 years of experience in HR Operations, Process Documentation, and Compliance.
* Advanced MS Excel (Mandatory): High proficiency in handling data sets, creating dashboards, and using complex formulas/pivots.
* SOP \& Policy Writing: Strong documentation abilities with a solid understanding of process mapping and policy formulation.
* Compliance Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of Indian Labour Laws and regulatory frameworks.
* Conflict Resolution \& Communication: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of handling sensitive grievances and escalations professionally.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.

**Why Join IITIL?**

* 100% Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the independence of working remotely within a collaborative team environment.

* Growth Opportunity: Direct involvement in building scalable HR processes, policies, and analytics in a data\-driven enterprise.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with examples of HR dashboards or SOPs created to **deepak.soni@iitil.com.**

description:
**About Us**
============


Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.  

For the better. Together.

  


Are you passionate about connecting great people with meaningful global opportunities? At Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, we are strengthening the way we attract, select, and engage talent across countries, cultures, and markets. As part of our Global Talent Acquisition team, you will play an important role in building international talent pipelines, supporting specialist and leadership hiring, and creating a professional, consistent, and engaging candidate experience across the Hellmann world.  

  

This position can be based in one of our Hellmann countries, subject to local employment setup and business requirements, ideally in India or The Philippines.**About the Job**
=================

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes for global specialist and leadership positions across multiple functions, regions and international markets
* Partner closely with senior Stakeholders, Hiring Managers and HR Business Partners across different countries, cultures, and time zones to clarify role requirements, define success profiles, and align on selection decisions

* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for critical global roles and future business needs. Coordinate structured selection processes involving cross\-regional interview panels, ensuring clear communication, timely feedback, and a state\-of\-the art candidate experience
* Conduct structured interviews and support hiring decisions based on role\-related criteria, professional expertise, leadership potential, motivation and cultural fit
* Act as a trusted recruiting advisor to stakeholders by challenging requirements, advising on market realities, and ensuring a fair, consistent, and evidence\-based hiring process
* Use recruiting data, KPIs, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities and contribute to the continuous development of global recruiting standards, tools, and processes
**About You**
=============

* A degree or equivalent professional experience in HR, business, psychology, recruitment, or a related field.
* Proven recruitment experience in an international environment, ideally including specialist, professional, and leadership hiring across countries or regions
* Strong active sourcing skills and the ability to identify, approach, and engage passive candidates in different markets
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and hiring managers, with the confidence to advise, challenge, and influence constructively
* Strong knowledge of modern recruiting technologies, applicant tracking systems, and data\-driven recruiting practices
* Excellent communication skills in English; German and/or another additional language is an advantage but not a requirement
* A structured, proactive, and solution\-oriented working style combined with strong service orientation
* High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential information
* Curiosity, cultural awareness, and the ability to collaborate effectively across countries, time zones, and different stakeholder expectations

* A strong Team Spirit and a lot of fun together
* A safe, multi\-cultural and inclusive environment
* Individual opportunities for growth and development

Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!

title: Senior Product Manager, Data & AI — Corporate Functions (HR & Legal)
description:
### **Senior Product Manager, Data \& AI — Corporate Functions (HR \& Legal)**


* JR\-162596
* Hybrid
* Bengaluru
* Technology Enablement
* Full time

**Who are we?**



Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

  


A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.



A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**About the Role**



We're building HR and Legal data products that power workforce planning, talent strategy, compliance, and risk management across the enterprise. These products unify data from core systems such as Workday, Agiloft, SFDC, ServiceNow, and are delivered through a unified enterprise analytics and intelligence platform: a trusted single source of reference that exposes insight through APIs, semantic models, dashboards, and conversational and agentic AI experiences.



As Product Manager, you'll help drive the data and analytics product strategy and roadmap for our Corporate Functions (HR and Legal). You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their strategic priorities, operating rhythms, and pain points — fragmented data, manual reporting, limited scenario planning, and governance gaps — and translate them into high\-impact, AI\-enabled data products that sharpen insight, automate reporting, and elevate HR and Legal as strategic advisors to the business.



This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, business strategy, and applied AI. You'll turn complex business needs into a clear product roadmap while working hand\-in\-hand with data engineers to ship scalable, reliable, and high\-impact solutions.



This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role for someone who can operate at both strategic and technical depth, partner effectively with engineering and business stakeholders, and who has hands\-on experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products.



**What You'll Do**


* **Partner \& advise:** Build trusted relationships with HR and Legal stakeholders, understanding their objectives, operating cadence, and core processes. Translate pain points (attrition risk, skills and talent strategy, DEI reporting, contract bottlenecks, compliance governance) into data product solutions and manage expectations within and across functions.

* **Shape strategy \& roadmap:** Drive the product strategy and an ROI\-informed roadmap, balancing quick\-win delivery against foundational platform work, technical debt, and scalability.

* **Build data products:** Own function\-grade semantic models that integrate with the enterprise platform, model store, and query APIs. Productize analytics and AI/ML services while upholding platform principles: system of reference, domain data ownership, and full lineage, provenance, and auditability.

* **Deliver end\-to\-end:** Lead delivery from problem framing and data feasibility through model evaluation, deployment, and adoption. Build prototypes, define test cases and UAT, run agile release cycles, and ensure data quality, security, and compliance on everything shipped.

* **Analyze the market:** Track industry practices and emerging HR and Legal analytics and AI trends (predictive attrition, skills intelligence, contract analytics, compliance automation), and bring in best\-in\-class governance frameworks (GDPR, data privacy, records compliance).

* **Build business cases \& measure success:** Develop financial models and opportunity reviews, and define the metrics that prove product value (adoption, reporting cycle\-time reduction, forecast accuracy, model quality, automation ROI).

* **Collaborate cross\-functionally:** Work hand\-in\-hand with data platform, data science, AI/ML, and engineering teams on pipeline design, backlog refinement, and product training.
  


**What You'll Bring**


* 8\+ years of product management experience (3\+ years as a Data Analyst/similar role supporting cross\-functional global business units, for candidates coming from an analytics background), with at least 2–3 years focused on data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML products.

* Bachelor's degree preferred in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.

* Strong technical fluency: enterprise data platforms, semantic and data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, and the AI/ML lifecycle (data prep, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring). Comfortable with SQL and hands\-on data analysis.


* Demonstrated experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products (predictive models, LLM\-based applications, automation tools).

* Solid grasp of data governance: lineage, provenance, auditability, and domain data ownership.

* Knowledge of HR and/or Legal concepts (workforce planning, people analytics, compliance, data privacy, contract lifecycle management) is a strong plus.

* Excellent communicator who can simplify the complex, flex between technical depth and business storytelling, and build trust across HR, Legal, IT, Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams.

* Bias for action and ownership: breaks down complex problems, drives alignment, and stays decisive.

description:
***Brief Job Description:***

Fuzion PR is looking for a Finance Analyst to strengthen our existing finance team: the ability to combine clean, professional communication with sharp analytical thinking. This isn't a back\-office number\-crunching role alone, you'll be writing emails that represent the finance function, reading and understanding contracts. Your role is to help leadership make financial decisions by turning financial data into actionable business insights.

***Why Join Fuzion?***

You won't just maintain financial records\- you'll help shape business decisions. As Fuzion grows, this role offers the opportunity to build capabilities in FP\&A, business finance, automation and strategic reporting while working closely with senior leadership.

***Detailed R\&R:***

· Own monthly MIS and leadership dashboards covering key financial KPIs.

· Analyze financial data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.

· Prepare budget vs. actual reports, variance analysis and support annual budgeting and periodic forecasting.

· Support cash flow planning and prepare short\-term cash flow forecasts.

· Build and improve dashboards, trackers and reports using Excel, Tally and AI.

· Review vendor and client contracts to identify financial terms, obligations and commercial risks.

· Draft and manage professional financial correspondence with clients, vendors and internal stakeholders.

· Identify process improvements, automation opportunities and AI\-enabled reporting enhancements.

· Collaborate with the existing finance operations team on invoicing, reconciliations and statutory reporting whenever required.

· Present findings and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.

· KRAs would include audit of finance books to submit regular reports on revenue analysis profitability analysis, cash flow forecasting and trend analysis

***Skills \& Competencies:***

· Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, Lookups, Power Query preferred).

· Exposure to Power BI or similar BI tools is an advantage.

· Understanding of accounting principles and financial statements.

· Ability to convert financial data into actionable business insights.

· High attention to detail with ownership and curiosity

***What Success Looks Like for this role:***

· Leadership receives reliable monthly business dashboards.

· Meaningful insights on profitability, costs and cash flow.

· Budgeting and forecasting processes become structured.

· Finance reporting becomes faster, clearer and more automated.

· Recommendations influence business decisions.

***Qualifications and Requirements:***

· Finance Analyst with a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience, or a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) (freshers as well as experienced candidates are welcome to apply).

· CA aspirants (currently pursuing CA) can also apply

· Candidates with prior audit experience will have a distinct advantage

***Remuneration:***

· Depends on previous experience; no bar for the right candidate

title: Member Technical Staff
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------


Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost\-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


As a member of the Siemens PowerPro core R\&D team, you will develop the software engines that power RTL and gate\-level power estimation. Your focus will be on driving the architecture of new features, building applications to aid power analysis, and developing high\-performance algorithms for simulation and power estimation. This is an excellent opportunity for freshers and early\-career engineers to grow their technical expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and optimize core C\+\+ software applications for RTL and gate\-level power analysis and estimation.
* Drive the architecture, design, and implementation of new features within the power estimation product line.
* Design efficient algorithms to handle and process large simulation waveforms, switching activity data, and design netlists.
* Explore and integrate AI/ML techniques to improve the performance, scalability, and accuracy of core power estimation models.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver robust, high\-performance solutions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
* Strong foundational knowledge of C\+\+, STL, Data Structures, and Algorithms.
* Basic understanding of digital design concepts using Verilog or VHDL.
* 0\+ years of experience (freshers and entry\-level candidates welcome).
* Knowledge of scripting languages such as Tcl, Python, Perl, Sed, or Awk is a plus.
* Familiarity with EDA tools, logic simulation, or hardware waveform formats is desirable.

**Why Us**
----------


We are Siemens:


At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.


You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
--------------------------


Siemens is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate unlawfully on the grounds of age, disability, gender assignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and parental status, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or trade union membership. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.

**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**
--------------------------------------------

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
.
  
Other Requirements

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

title: Performance Testing Consultant (Mid Level)
description:
* Education: Graduation in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3\-5 years of hands on experience in performance testing and performance engineering for web or enterprise applications.
* Strong expertise in LoadRunner for scripting, scenario design, execution, and analysis.
* Proven experience in end to end Performance Testing (load, stress, endurance, spike) including test planning and execution.
* Solid background in Performance Engineering, including bottleneck identification, tuning recommendations, and capacity considerations.
* Practical experience using Dynatrace (or similar APM tools) for monitoring, tracing, and root cause analysis during performance tests.
* Hands on experience with Cloud Performance Testing for applications hosted on public or private cloud environments.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills to interact with cross functional and client teams.
* Design, plan, and execute end to end performance test strategies (load, stress, endurance, scalability) for complex enterprise and cloud based applications.
* Develop, parameterize, and maintain robust LoadRunner scripts, scenarios, and workloads aligned with business usage patterns, including advanced correlation, parameterization, think time modeling, error handling, custom logic, and data driven frameworks.
* Perform in depth performance analysis using Dynatrace and other monitoring tools to identify bottlenecks across application, database, network, and infrastructure layers.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, platform, infrastructure, and operations teams to define performance scope, SLAs/SLOs, KPIs, and success criteria, interpret performance results, diagnose root causes, and recommend tuning and optimization strategies.
* Lead performance engineering activities, including capacity planning, sizing, and performance modeling for on premise and cloud environments, with a strong focus on microservices, REST APIs, async workflows, and batch processing.
* Conduct cloud performance testing across major platforms (e.g., autoscaling, elasticity, resilience), validating SLAs and non functional requirements, and evaluating limits/requests, node saturation, and cluster level constraints.
* Prepare clear, data driven performance reports, dashboards, and presentations for technical and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical findings in a concise and business relevant manner.
* Guide project teams on performance best practices throughout the SDLC and support shift left performance testing approaches, including early requirements clarification and performance risk identification.
* Mentor junior team members in performance testing techniques, tools usage, and analysis methods, fostering a self driven, ownership mindset within the team.
* Independently identify performance work items, define approaches, and execute performance engagements end to end, including test plan creation, scenario design, data modeling, and dashboard setup.
* Drive performance analysis and bottleneck identification across the full stack (application, JVM/GC, database, infrastructure, and container platforms) without waiting for direction, providing concrete tuning recommendations.

title: Desktop Support Engineer L1
description:
We are looking for a Desktop Support Engineer (L1\) to provide first\-level technical support for the cinema theatre's IT infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining desktops, laptops, printers, POS systems, networking devices, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day IT operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 1 technical support for desktop, laptop, and peripheral issues.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows operating systems and software applications.
* Support POS systems, ticketing counters, kiosks, and payment devices.
* Install and maintain printers, scanners, barcode scanners, and biometric devices.
* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and network connectivity issues.
* Configure and support email clients (Outlook) and Microsoft Office applications.
* Perform hardware installation, replacement, and preventive maintenance.
* Create and manage user accounts, passwords, and access permissions.
* Respond to IT support tickets within the defined SLA.
* Coordinate with senior IT engineers or vendors for complex issues.
* Maintain IT asset inventory and documentation.
* Ensure antivirus, software updates, and system security are up to date.
* Provide technical support during movie releases, weekends, and special events when required.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of Windows 10/11 operating systems.
* Basic understanding of LAN, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience with desktop hardware, printers, and peripherals.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office 365 and Outlook.
* Basic knowledge of Active Directory is an advantage.
* Good troubleshooting and communication skills.
* Ability to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
* Certifications such as A\+, N\+, CCNA, or Microsoft certifications are an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **Freshers or 0–2 years** of experience in Desktop Support / IT Support.
* Experience in multiplexes, retail, hospitality, or customer\-facing environments is preferred.

**Preferred Candidate**

* Strong problem\-solving ability.
* Customer\-focused attitude.
* Team player with good interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts.

**CONTACT HR** : **\+91 8807374254 / \+91 8248996756**

title: TSR - JOG
description:
**Job Title** **Territory Service Representative – Operations** **Function** **Operations** **Reports To**  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable) **Location** **Branch / Service Centre (Location Agnostic)** **Travel Required** **25%****50%****75%****þ** **About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations*** Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence*** Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration*** Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

**Education**:* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**  

**Technical Skills:*** Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

 **Why join DHL Blue Dart?**  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

 **Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a proactive and target\-driven **Field Sales \& Marketing Executive** to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for generating new business leads through direct field visits, building relationships with local businesses and institutions, and supporting our sales team in closing deals. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys client\-facing work, daily travel, and growing within a fast\-scaling IT infrastructure company.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visit prospective clients on\-site (schools, hospitals, retail outlets, corporate offices, and other local businesses) to generate new leads
* Identify and qualify potential business opportunities within assigned territories
* Coordinate with the internal telecalling team to schedule client meetings and site surveys
* Build and maintain strong relationships with local business owners and decision\-makers
* Follow up on quotations and support the sales team through to deal closure
* Submit daily/weekly field visit reports and lead status updates

**Requirements:**

* Graduate in any discipline (Marketing/Business background preferred)
* Prior field sales/marketing experience preferred; motivated freshers may also apply
* Own two\-wheeler with valid driving license (mandatory)
* Strong communication skills in Telugu, Hindi, and English
* Self\-driven, comfortable with daily field travel and target\-based work

**What We Offer:**

* Performance\-based incentives for target achievement
* Training and mentorship in enterprise sales
* Growth opportunities within a scaling IT infrastructure group

title: Level Designer - Unity
description:
**About 8Chili** 




 8Chili is building the digital workforce operating system for pharmaceutical manufacturing, a connected suite of tools that trains, guides, and uplifts the people on the shop floor. Our products span immersive VR and AR training, AI\-powered shop\-floor assistance, and modern learning platforms, all built toward one goal: enhancing the way the pharma workforce learns and works.
 



 Immersive training is one of the most powerful surfaces in that ecosystem, and it's where this role lives. As our Level Designer, you'll craft the VR environments operators step into: spaces that feel real, read clearly, and hold up under close inspection in a headset, so people can train safely and repeatably before ever touching a live line.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design and build training environments in Unity, laying out spaces, staging equipment, and guiding the user's attention through the scene.
* Own lighting: Set up and optimize lighting to make environments believable and performant on standalone VR hardware.
* Work with materials and textures to give surfaces the right look and feel, balancing visual fidelity against performance.
* Assemble scenes from 3D assets, tuning placement, scale, and composition for clarity and immersion.
* Collaborate with developers, artists, and subject\-matter experts to translate real manufacturing settings into training\-ready spaces.



  





**How this role grows** 




 You'll start by owning environments, lighting, and materials. Over time, you'll grow into contributing on the simulation side — the interactive logic that turns a well\-built space into a scenario that actually teaches. Our intention is for you to master both crafts: the environment
 *and* 
 the experience.
 



  





**What you bring** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with lighting in Unity and how to keep frame rates high.
* Solid working knowledge of materials and textures in Unity.
* Comfortable and productive in the Unity game engine day to day.
* Basic knowledge of 3D asset design and how assets move through a pipeline.
* An eye for spatial flow, composition, and how people move through and read a space.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to VR/AR development or optimizing for standalone headsets.
* Familiarity with tools like Maya, Blender, Substance, and other modeling/texturing tools.



  





**What we offer** 



* ₹30,000/month
* The chance to shape how thousands of operators learn, on a product already deployed with leading pharma companies.
* A small, fast\-moving team where your work ships.

Job Description – QC MicrobiologistAbout the Company

Liquimine LLP is a rapidly growing beverage manufacturing company specializing in Carbonated Soft Drinks (CSD), Packaged Drinking Water, and Alkaline Water. We are committed to manufacturing safe, high\-quality products by maintaining stringent Quality Management Systems and GMP practices.

We are looking for a dedicated and detail\-oriented QC Microbiologist to strengthen our Quality Control Department at our manufacturing facility in Manor, Palghar.

Key ResponsibilitiesMicrobiological Testing

* Perform routine microbiological analysis of raw water, treated water, process water, finished products, and environmental samples.
* Conduct Total Plate Count (TPC), Yeast \& Mold Count, Coliform, E. coli, and other microbiological analyses as per BIS/FSSAI standards.
* Carry out environmental monitoring of production and laboratory areas.
* Perform swab testing of equipment, filling lines, packaging areas, and personnel hygiene.

Laboratory Operations

* Prepare microbiological media, reagents, and culture solutions.
* Maintain microbial cultures and reference organisms.
* Sterilize laboratory glassware, media, and equipment using autoclaves.
* Ensure proper calibration and maintenance of microbiology laboratory instruments.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Maintain accurate laboratory records, test reports, and microbiology logs.
* Review microbiological results and immediately report any out\-of\-specification (OOS) findings.
* Prepare trend analysis reports for microbial monitoring.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GLP, HACCP, FSSAI, and internal Quality Management Systems.
* Support internal and external quality audits.

Quality Assurance Support

* Participate in investigations related to microbial contamination.
* Assist in CAPA implementation and root cause analysis.
* Coordinate with Production and QA departments for corrective and preventive actions.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation effectiveness.

General Responsibilities

* Maintain laboratory cleanliness and safety.
* Ensure proper disposal of microbiological waste.
* Follow all safety protocols and PPE requirements.
* Perform any additional quality\-related tasks assigned by the Quality Manager.

Candidate RequirementsEducational Qualification

* B.Sc./M.Sc. in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.

Experience

* 1–5 years of experience in microbiological testing within the beverage, food, pharmaceutical, dairy, or packaged drinking water industry.
* Freshers with strong laboratory knowledge may also be considered.

Technical Skills

* Good understanding of microbiological testing methods.
* Knowledge of GMP, GLP, HACCP, FSSAI, and BIS requirements.
* Familiarity with aseptic techniques and laboratory best practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and documentation.

Desired Skills

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* High attention to detail.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and under production timelines.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

* Strong understanding of customer journeys, CRM, user segmentation, and lifecycle marketing.
