description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience

 The Network Engineer is responsible for the provisioning, installation, configuration, operation, and maintenance of network systems, hardware, software, and related infrastructure. This role requires more than 6 years of hands\-on experience with advanced networking technologies, firewalls, switches, site\-to\-site connectivity, and cloud networking. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in routing, switching, BGP, Anycast, firewalls (Barracuda preferred), Cisco Nexus/Catalyst, Aruba, Ruckus, and Kubernetes networking (Cilium/Calico). The engineer must demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills, the ability to design and document detailed network diagrams, and the ownership mindset to ensure reliable and scalable network operations.

 ▪ Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain all network devices, including switches, routers, firewalls, and CNIs.

 ▪ Architect and manage BGP routing, Anycast deployments, and dynamic routing strategies.

 ▪ Provide solutions to complex problems on the integration of various technologies.
   

  

 ▪ Get on troubleshooting calls at short notice and work with operations and OEMs to resolve.
   

  

 ▪ Design plans as well as lead initiatives for the optimization and restructuring of network architecture.
   

  

 ▪ Maintain an up\-to\-date knowledge of network administration and firmware integration.
   

  

 ▪ Monitor the environmental conditions of a data center to ensure they are optimum for servers, routers, and other devices.
   

  

 ▪ Lead initiatives for optimization, resiliency, and security hardening of network infrastructure.
   

  

 ▪ Collaborate with operations and OEM vendors to resolve complex network challenges.
   

  

****The Must\-Haves \-****
 ▪ Strong expertise in routing and switching across enterprise and data center networks.
   

  

 ▪ Hands\-on experience with firewalls (Barracuda preferred), ASA/FTD, and advanced perimeter security.
   

  

 ▪ Deep knowledge of Cisco Nexus \& Catalyst switches, Aruba, and Ruckus networking.

**▪ Experience With Firewalls, Barracuda Preferred.**

title: WAN Configuration Engineer
description:
The WAN Configuration Engineer will be responsible for configuring, deploying, and supporting Wide Area Network (WAN) solutions across enterprise environments. The role involves working on routers, firewalls, SD\-WAN platforms, and ensuring high availability, security, and performance of WAN connectivity.
   

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

  

* Configure and deploy WAN circuits (MPLS, DIA, Broadband, LTE).
* Configure and manage enterprise routers and switches.
* Implement and support SD\-WAN solutions.
* Perform routing protocol configuration (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP).
* Configure IPsec VPN and site\-to\-site tunnels.
* Manage VLANs, NAT, ACLs, and QoS policies.
* Coordinate with ISPs for circuit installation and troubleshooting.
* Perform WAN performance monitoring and optimization.
* Troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 network issues.
* Maintain configuration documentation and network diagrams.
* Participate in change management and incident management processes.
* Provide L2/L3 support for WAN\-related incidents.



  

  




**Required Technical Skills** 
  

  

  

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience with routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP.
* Experience in MPLS and SD\-WAN technologies.
* Knowledge of VPN technologies (IPsec, SSL VPN).
* Understanding of QoS and traffic shaping.
* Experience with firewall configuration.
* Knowledge of DNS, DHCP, NTP.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, etc.).
* Basic knowledge of network security concepts.


**Preferred Skills** 
  

* Experience with Cisco / Juniper / Fortinet devices.
* Knowledge of cloud connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).
* ITIL knowledge.
* Scripting knowledge (Python or basic automation).


**Certifications (Preferred)** 
  

  

  

* CCNA / CCNP
* JNCIA / JNCIP
* SD\-WAN\-related certifications


 Benefits
   

  

* Health insurance coverage for Self, Spouse, and Kids.
* Long\-term benefit savings plan with employer matching contributions
* Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organization

 We are seeking a

In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, optimizing, and troubleshooting IP networking components in a mission\-critical datacenter network built on Cisco Nexus platforms. This is a hands\-on role requiring expertise in routing, switching, security, and load balancing, as well as a passion for automation and continuous improvement.

* Review, analyze, and execute network change requests.
* Execute, document, and develop network automation for repetitive tasks.


**Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of Cisco IOS (Nexus OS preferred).
* Demonstrated knowledge of platform operating systems (router platforms, LAN, WAN, and router protocols), MPLS, OSPF, and BGP, and how they interact with the network.
* Experience with datacenter networking (DC fabric, interoffice routing, site\-to\-site VPNs).
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a data\-driven approach to solving complex network issues.
* Ability to create and maintain network documentation (diagrams, runbooks).
* Experience with implementations of solutions involving large data centers, interoffice routing plans, site2site VPNs, FWs, IPSec, monitoring, etc., is a plus

description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start\-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values\-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989\. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full\-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a
 **Senior Network Engineer – LAN** 
 to join our global team supporting a large\-scale SaaS production environment. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, optimizing, and troubleshooting IP networking components in a mission\-critical datacenter network built on Cisco Nexus platforms. This is a hands\-on role requiring expertise in routing, switching, security, and load balancing, as well as a passion for automation and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to work on large\-scale, enterprise networks supporting millions of customer interactions, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to keep systems secure, resilient, and future\-ready.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Interact with external customers to troubleshoot any network connectivity\-related issues.
* Partner closely with Network Architects and Engineers to improve data\-center network environments.
* Initiate multiple projects for Network Operation improvements.
* Partner with internal business units to best understand the organization's needs and continuously improve and apply standards for operational excellence.
* Review, analyze, and execute network change requests.
* Execute, document, and develop network automation for repetitive tasks.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience working with medium\-to\-large enterprise networks.
* Hands\-on expertise in: Network security (Palo Alto firewalls), Load balancing (F5 or equivalent), Routing (MPLS, OSPF, BGP), Switching (Cisco Nexus 9k/7k/5k/2k).
* Working knowledge of Cisco IOS (Nexus OS preferred).
* Demonstrated knowledge of platform operating systems (router platforms, LAN, WAN, and router protocols), MPLS, OSPF, and BGP, and how they interact with the network.
* Experience with datacenter networking (DC fabric, interoffice routing, site\-to\-site VPNs).
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a data\-driven approach to solving complex network issues.
* Ability to create and maintain network documentation (diagrams, runbooks).
* Experience with implementations of solutions involving large data centers, interoffice routing plans, site2site VPNs, FWs, IPSec, monitoring, etc., is a plus


**Additional Information**
**We offer:**
* Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year\-over\-year revenue growth.
* Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
* Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
* Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
* Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
* Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team\-building company social events.
* Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.


**Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.**

title: Systems Test Engineering
description:
Required Skills \& Competencies Test Architecture Strong logical and analytical thinking. Ability to decompose complex system behaviors into structured and scalable test cases. Experience creating end\-to\-end validation strategies and ensuring comprehensive test coverage. Domain Translation Ability to understand operational and engineering concepts and transform them into measurable test requirements. Strong systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capabilities. Black\-Box Troubleshooting Expertise in identifying system states, isolating variables, and validating workarounds. Strong defect investigation and debugging skills. Ability to create concise, high\-quality defect reports for development teams.
   

  

 Role: Systems Test Engineer Location: India (with collaboration across global teams) Experience: 3–8 Years Domain: Autonomous Vehicles / Mobility / Embedded Systems / Software Testing Job Summary We are seeking a highly analytical and detail\-oriented Systems Test Engineer to design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies for complex autonomous vehicle systems. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating high\-level engineering requirements into structured test scenarios, identifying system defects, and collaborating with cross\-functional engineering teams to improve product quality and reliability. The role demands strong logical reasoning, system\-level thinking, and expertise in troubleshooting complex software and hardware interactions. Key Responsibilities Design and develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and validation strategies for autonomous driving systems and related software components. Translate abstract product and engineering requirements into detailed, parameterized testing scenarios. Execute functional, integration, system, and regression testing activities across multiple environments. Analyze system behavior, identify defects, isolate root causes, and document findings with clarity and precision. Perform black\-box testing by evaluating system responses without access to underlying source code. Collaborate with software, systems, simulation, and validation engineers to resolve issues and improve product quality. Drive test coverage optimization while avoiding redundant test scenarios. Create detailed bug reports and provide actionable feedback to engineering teams. Support continuous improvement of testing methodologies, tools, and processes.
   

  

 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred for candidates with a 3\-year undergraduate degree. Experience in software testing, systems validation, automotive testing, embedded systems testing, or related domains. Knowledge of test automation frameworks, defect tracking tools, and software development lifecycles. Familiarity with Linux environments, scripting, and data analysis tools is desirable. Candidates from the following areas are highly preferred: System Test Engineering Software Quality Assurance Embedded Systems Validation Automotive Testing Autonomous Vehicle Testing Robotics Testing Controls Engineering Simulation \& Validation Engineering Success Factors Exceptional problem\-solving and critical thinking skills. Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Ability to work effectively in cross\-functional global teams. Attention to detail and commitment to product quality. Passion for innovative mobility and autonomous vehicle technologies.

title: Assistant Manager - Global IP and Ethernet Engineering
description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description:
   

  

 Responsible for different aspects of engineering activities to provide differentiated services and solutions. These may also include product evaluation, solution designing and testing and roll out plan for existing and new services, including design of tools needed for operation of these new services and systems. This is an operational role, responsible for delivering results that have direct impact on day\-to\-day engineering operations in the respective areas of Network/SDWAN/Cloud \& security/Unified Collaboration/Mobility \& IoT.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Systems engineering for front\-end processors, cloud infrastructure, multiplexes, LAN/WAN communications, network nodes, and switches.
   

  

 Ensure timely rollout of system enhancements, migration, deployment, and optimization projects.
   

  

 Involved in planning, architecture designing, developing, and testing solutions and service products riding on network or across multiple network layers.
   

  

 Involved in the development of systems including storage, load balancers, servers, and routers/switches.
   

  

 Manage physical connectivity, hardware \& automation tools.
   

  

 Resolve issues based on escalations from the end user.
   

  

 Perform integration with existing systems and conduct service validation prior to hand over to Service Operations team.
   

  

 Direct the assurance team in adopting measures for fault rate \& ticket rate reduction.
   

  

 Ensure engineering Projects completed within target dates within budget and agreed scope.
   

  

 Performance tuning and automation of application.
   

  

 Desired Skill sets
   

  

 Candidate should have 4 to 6 years of working experience in Network domain
   

  

 Should have good knowledge in routing, switching, Layer 3 \& 2 VPN, MPLS, Multicast, QOS and encryption technologies.
   

  

 Should have good knowledge in IT systems, fault \& performance management tools used in Network Domain
   

  

 Should have knowledge in Cloud service provider domain, like Azure, AWS, GCP etc. their architecture, routing design and so on.
   

  

 Good to have knowledge in network automation using Ansible and other platforms.
   

  

 Good to have knowledge in Virtualization platforms like EXSI, KVM etc, also virtualization platform orchestrators like Open stack and others.
   

  

 Good to have knowledge in scripting languages like Python, XML, YAML etc.
   

  

 Candidate should be open minded, willing to learn any new technology and take up projects in those new technologies.

title: System Engineer
description:
We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!
   

  

 Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud\-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low\- and medium\-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.
   

  

 JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE
   

  

**Role \& Responsibility**
* To draw Control circuit for RMU including Communications interfaces RTUs, HMIs, and IEDs.
* To submit various stage drawing submission within defined timeline.
* To co ordinate with cross functional team for mechanical design finalisation, coordinate with vendors for equipment offers
* Issue Change management in time for applicable orders.
* To create part number , change notes, Compliance reports, GTP for various equipment .
* To participate in customer meetings for drawing approval, kick off meetings etc.
* Travelling is involved at customer offices for drawing approvals if required .


**Candidate Profile**
* Candidate must have 2\-3 years of experience in Engineering of MV switchgear.
* Candidate must have BE Electrical from reputed institution/ University in full time course.
* Candidate should know SLDs, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, and bill of materials (BOM),Nx tools\+ .
* Candidate should be able to Select and size CTs, PTs, protection relays, busbars, and associated equipment.
* Candidate should be capable to Review customer specifications and ensure compliance with applicable standards also competent enough to develop protection and control schemes for RMU switchgear in 11Kv and 33Kv system.
* Support quality audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar engineering tools.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


 WE DON'T NEED SUPERHEROES, JUST SUPER MINDS!
   

  

 WE’VE GOT QUITE A LOT TO OFFER. HOW ABOUT YOU?
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ\+, Abilities \& Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

 Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic\-areas/smart\-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers \#SL

title: System Engineer
description:
**Infrastructure Engineer** 




**Location:** 
**Bengaluru \| Hyderabad \| Chennai \| Pune \| Mumbai \| Gurgaon \| Noida (Hybrid)** 




**About Company** 




 An enterprise engineering consultancy is hiring Infrastructure Engineers to support a large\-scale banking transformation programme. The engineering team builds secure, highly available cloud infrastructure and virtual desktop environments supporting thousands of enterprise users across regulated production environments.
 



**Job Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Design, deploy, administer, and troubleshoot enterprise virtual desktop infrastructure using Omnissa Horizon, VMware Horizon, Workspace ONE Access, DEM, vSphere, ESXi, and related enterprise technologies.
* Build, maintain, and optimize highly available Windows infrastructure, virtualization platforms, hybrid cloud environments, networking, identity management, and enterprise infrastructure services.
* Investigate production issues across virtualization, Windows Server, Active Directory, networking, DNS, storage, and cloud infrastructure while ensuring rapid incident resolution and platform stability.
* Create high\-level and low\-level design documentation, implementation plans, operational runbooks, migration documentation, and infrastructure best practices for enterprise customers.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, and customer engineering teams to deliver migration projects, platform improvements, operational excellence, and enterprise support.
* Mentor junior engineers, participate in technical reviews, customer escalations, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and continuously improve operational standards across the infrastructure team.



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 6–12 years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Engineering, Platform Engineering, Virtualization, Cloud Infrastructure, or Enterprise IT environments.
* Strong hands\-on experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization technologies, enterprise infrastructure, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience working with enterprise virtual desktop technologies such as Omnissa Horizon, VMware Horizon, Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, or similar VDI platforms.
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, switching, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, VMware Cloud, AWS, or enterprise hybrid cloud environments is highly desirable.
* Strong customer\-facing communication, documentation, stakeholder management, troubleshooting, and mentoring skills.
* VMware, Omnissa, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or related infrastructure certifications are an added advantage.



**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to work on enterprise\-scale infrastructure, virtualization, and cloud transformation programmes supporting leading global organizations.
* Ownership of production infrastructure, virtualization platforms, migration projects, enterprise operations, customer escalations, and technical solution design.
* Close collaboration with cloud, networking, security, platform engineering, and enterprise infrastructure specialists on complex technical environments.
* Hybrid work model based in Bengaluru with competitive compensation, continuous learning opportunities, and exposure to modern enterprise infrastructure technologies.



**Hiring Process** 




**Round 1:** 
 Flexiple Interview focused on infrastructure engineering fundamentals, virtualization experience, Windows administration, cloud exposure, troubleshooting capability, communication skills, notice period, and compensation expectations.
 



**Round 2:** 
 Flexiple Profile Review to validate technical expertise, enterprise infrastructure experience, and overall role fit before client submission.
 



**Round 3:** 
 Client Technical Interview covering infrastructure architecture, virtualization, production troubleshooting, cloud platforms, networking, and enterprise support scenarios.
 



**Round 4:** 
 Client Stakeholder Discussion focused on customer communication, technical ownership, collaboration, documentation quality, and overall team fit.
 



  





**Applications are being reviewed this week. Apply today to be included in the first round of interviews.** 




**Not the right fit? Tag someone in your network who might be.**

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**Company overview:**
 TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no\-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission\-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate\-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi\-enterprise processes at global scale.
   

  

 Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi\-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
   

  

 Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
   

  

**About The Role**
**We are looking for an early\-career
 **Agentic AI Engineer** 
 to help build and evolve AI\-powered systems that automate and improve supply chain workflows. In this role, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers and data scientists to develop
 **agentic AI / GenAI features** 
 , integrate
 **knowledge\-based retrieval (RAG)** 
 patterns, and contribute to
 **testing and validation** 
 approaches for AI systems that can behave in non\-deterministic ways.**
**This is a strong opportunity for someone who is eager to grow in both
 **software engineering** 
 and
 **applied GenAI** 
 , and wants to work on real\-world enterprise problems in supply chain and (optionally) life sciences.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Support the design and implementation of agentic AI / GenAI systems that assist in automating supply chain workflows.
* Build and maintain backend services and integrations using Python and/or Java.
* Contribute to multi\-agent workflows, such as tool execution, routing, agent collaboration patterns, and task orchestration.
* Assist in creating testing and validation strategies for AI systems, including evaluation datasets, regression testing, and behavior monitoring.
* Help implement and improve knowledge base systems, including RAG pipelines, grounding strategies, and retrieval quality improvements.
* Contribute to experimentation with:
+ lightweight fine\-tuning approaches for small language models (SLMs)
+ reinforcement\-learning\-inspired improvement loops for NLP/GenAI tasks (where applicable)

* Partner with product and domain teams to understand supply chain needs and translate them into working software.
* Participate in code reviews, documentation, and operational support to ensure high\-quality production systems.


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s/Bachelors degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a closely related discipline.
* 0–2 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or ML engineering (internships and co\-ops count) OR equivalent experience
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, including writing production\-quality code.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure (academic, personal, or internship experience is acceptable).
* Interest or exposure to Generative AI concepts, such as LLMs, agent workflows, tool calling, or multi\-step reasoning.
* Understanding of core engineering fundamentals:
+ APIs and services
+ basic distributed systems concepts
+ debugging and performance basics
+ data structures \& algorithms

* Ability to learn quickly, take feedback well, and collaborate effectively in a team environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Coursework, projects, or hands\-on experience with agentic or multi\-step AI systems, including non\-deterministic behavior patterns.
* Exposure to designing knowledge base solutions, such as:
+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
+ embedding\-based search
+ hybrid search approaches
+ reranking or relevance evaluation

* Experience or academic background in one of the following:
+ fine\-tuning small language models (SLMs)
+ training or adapting NLP models
+ Reinforcement learning concepts applied to language systems

* Exposure to event\-driven or reactive systems
* Interest in supply chain domains (logistics, manufacturing, procurement, etc.).
* Knowledge of the life sciences supply chain is a plus, but not required.


****What Success Looks Like****
* You can take a defined task (e.g., building a new RAG retriever, improving evaluation coverage, or implementing a new agent tool) and deliver a working solution with support from senior engineers.
* You write clean, testable code and steadily improve your ability to debug real\-world production issues.
* You contribute to AI system reliability through experiments, evaluation improvements, and thoughtful engineering.


****Who You Are****
* Curious, motivated, and excited to build AI\-driven products that ship to real users.
* Comfortable working with a mix of predictable engineering tasks and emerging AI workflows.
* Strong team player with a growth mindset and a willingness to learn.

If you have questions about this privacy notice or need to contact us in connection with your personal data, including any requests to exercise your legal rights referred to at the end of this notice, please contact Candidate\-Privacy@tracelink.com.*

title: Software Engineer
description:
Join us as a Software Engineer
   

  

* This is an opportunity for a driven Software Engineer to build AI\-enabled products and workflows that solve real business problems
* You’ll engineer reliable, scalable software and automation that connects modern AI capabilities with real\-world risk and control processes
* We’re offering this role at associate level


 What you'll do
   

  

 In your new role, you’ll be working within a feature team to engineer software, scripts and tools, as well as liaising with other engineers, architects and business analysts across the platform.
   

  

**You’ll Also Be**
* Engineer and ship AI\-enabled software, services and automation that support and enhance controls and governance processes
* Integrate LLM capabilities, retrieval patterns and API\-based services into products and internal workflows in a secure, maintainable way
* Build, test, deploy and support backend services, scripts and lightweight web components across the full software lifecycle
* Design and improve orchestration for multi\-step workflows, event\-driven processes and cross\-system integrations
* Evaluate solution quality across accuracy, reliability, latency and cost, and refine implementations using testing, monitoring and structured feedback
* Collaborate with engineers and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions aligned to control’s strategy
* Improve automation, resilience and engineering quality through reusable components, better tooling and disciplined delivery practices


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 To take on this role, you’ll need a background in software engineering, software design, and architecture, and an understanding of how your area of expertise supports our customers.
   

  

**You’ll Also Need**
* Strong software engineering foundations like clean, testable code,Git,debugging, basic CI/CD, solid Python for backend/AI integration, JavaScript/TypeScript for web,and good SQL/data handling
* Designing or consuming REST and GraphQL APIs; LLM integration (prompts, configuration, evaluation); retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases; workflow/orchestration; and event\-driven architectures (queues, webhooks, pub/sub)
* Secure, scalable systems experience: authentication and integration patterns (OAuth, API keys, service accounts, schema transformation); familiarity with cloud and enterprise platforms (managed AI, serverless, business systems); and focus on data pipelines, quality, latency, accuracy and cost
* Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to turn business needs into technical solutions and explain trade\-offs clearly. Curiosity and adaptability in a fast\-changing AI landscape, with the judgement to evaluate new tools quickly and avoid over\-reliance on any single stack
* Experience or awareness of risk, controls frameworks or enterprise risk management (e.g. EWRMF) is beneficial but not essential

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 The hands\-on builder of the AI\-augmented enterprise, operating in a 1 to 3 person Frontier pod. Applies agentic AI, prompt engineering and AI\-driven delivery to build, ship and operate AI\-native systems end to end, spanning software, infrastructure, data, quality and operations. Specifies intent for AI coding agents, validates and integrates their output, orchestrates agent pipelines, and stands behind what the pod builds in production. A full\-stack generalist who reaches for an AI tool first. The pod is accountable for a measured customer outcome, not just working code: the Frontier Engineer validates AI outputs in the domain context and owns what is built, permanently, in production.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Orchestrate multi\-agent coding pipelines and integrate agent outputs into production environments.
* Specify intent prompts for AI coding agents; review and validate AI\-generated code for quality and correctness.
* Design and build RAG pipelines, vector stores and knowledge bases so agents are grounded and accurate.
* Deploy and operate LLMs and agents in production; monitor drift and implement safety guardrails.
* Build AI\-embedded workflows and applications using enterprise AI builders and automation platforms.
* Automate L1/L2 operations using AIOps tooling and intelligent incident routing.


**What You Bring**
**Core skills:** 
 Agentic coding \& multi\-agent orchestration (LangChain/AutoGen/LangGraph), Prompt \& intent engineering, AI\-generated code validation, RAG pipeline design, Vector database management, LLMOps \& model lifecycle management, Guardrail implementation, AIOps \& observability, CI/CD for AI systems.
   

  

**Competencies** 
 : Agentic Engineering \& Orchestration, Context \& Retrieval Engineering, Production AI Operations (LLMOps), AI Code Quality \& Validation, Full\-Stack AI Delivery, Domain Fluency \& Contextual Judgment, Business\-Outcome Orientation.
   

  

****ENTRY AND GROWTH****
**Experience** 
 : 3\-10 yrs technical delivery with strong AI\-tool fluency.
   

  

**Entry** 
 : Pass the Frontier CoE assessment (full\-stack delivery: Dev, Infra, Cloud, Production, Domain \+ AI foundations); complete the 4\-week build bootcamp (ship a working application in a lean pod).
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Builds, ships and permanently owns AI\-native systems end to end in a small Frontier pod, and is measured on the customer outcome the pod commits to, not on technical throughput alone.

title: Scrum Master
description:
***hackajob** 
 is collaborating with
 **Barclays** 
 to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.*
 Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences. As a part of the team, you will deliver technology stack, using strong analytical and problem solving skills to understand the business requirements and deliver quality solutions. You'll be working on complex technical problems that will involve detailed analytical skills and analysis. This will be done in conjunction with fellow engineers, business analysts and business stakeholders.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master you should have experience with:
   

  

* All agile events like Sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Actively identify and resolve blockers to maintain team momentum and delivery schedule.
* Expert in Agile Practices and methodologies and help teams to adopt them.
* Foster Collaboration, Build trust, encourage transparency, and promote shared problem\-solving.
* Monitor Performance. Track metrics like velocity and burndown charts to guide improvements.
* Enable Tooling, Support automation, and reporting tools to streamline workflows.
* Practice empathy, stewardship, and community building.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Ability to mentor and guide junior team members.
* Collaborative mindset with a focus on team success.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role will be based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The IT Development Lead / Scrum Master is responsible for planning, organizing, and coordinating the workload of IT developers to ensure the timely delivery of software applications, enhancements, and digital solutions. The role facilitates Agile development practices, manages sprint activities, prioritizes development tasks, and ensures effective collaboration between developers, business stakeholders, product owners, and support teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plan, prioritize, and allocate development tasks across IT development teams.
* Manage sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

* Monitor team workload, resource capacity, and project delivery timelines.
* Ensure timely development, testing, and deployment of applications and enhancements.
* Track progress, risks, dependencies, and development KPIs.
* Remove blockers and support developers in resolving technical and process issues.
* Collaborate with business users, product owners, architects, QA, and infrastructure teams.
* Promote Agile best practices, continuous improvement, and high\-performance teamwork.
* Ensure development deliverables meet quality, security, and business requirements.
* Provide project status reports and delivery updates to management.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Scrum Master Certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience working with IT development teams in an Agile environment.


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.
   

  

**Work Experience**
* Agile Scrum \& Kanban Methodologies
* IT Development Project Management
* Sprint \& Backlog Management
* Resource and Capacity Planning
* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Jira, Azure DevOps, Git
* Stakeholder Management, Risk \& Issue Management and Team Leadership and Coordination


**Key Competencies**
* Leadership and Team Management
* Planning and Prioritization
* Communication and Collaboration
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Delivery and Results Orientation
* Continuous Improvement Mindset


**Success Criteria**
* Ensure effective workload management and optimal utilization of IT development resources.
* Deliver software projects and sprint commitments on time while maintaining quality and stakeholder satisfaction.

 Agile, Capable, and Committed, which form an integral part of who we are, we constantly strive to provide an inclusive work environment. Our employees come from varied cultural and social backgrounds, and we strive each day to work towards making sa.global a great place to work.
   

  

**Values of sa.global**
* Contribute towards a working environment that represents “one sa.global” where everyone is seen as an equal, and equality and diversity is championed.

**About The Role**
 The Senior Technical Writer will own the development and maintenance of software and product documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
   

  

 This includes planning documentation requirements, gathering technical information, creating and editing content, managing review and approval cycles, and ensuring materials remain current as products and features evolve.
   

  

 The role will also help strengthen documentation processes, templates, style standards, and content governance across the organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop clear and comprehensive documentation for software products, features, integrations, and technical solutions.
* Create and maintain user guides, administrator guides, configuration guides, release notes, knowledge\-base articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting materials.
* Translate complex technical concepts into accessible content for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Partner with product, engineering, implementation, support, and consulting teams to gather and validate information.
* Participate in product demonstrations, planning sessions, and release discussions to identify documentation requirements.
* Manage documentation projects from initial scoping through drafting, review, approval, publication, and ongoing maintenance.
* Review existing content for accuracy, usability, consistency, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish and maintain documentation standards, templates, terminology, and style guidelines.
* Ensure documentation is aligned with product releases and communicated within agreed timelines.
* Organize content so users can quickly find and understand the information they need.
* Incorporate diagrams, screenshots, workflows, and other visual elements where they improve understanding.
* Use feedback, support trends, and user needs to continuously improve documentation.
* Mentor or provide editorial guidance to colleagues contributing to technical content.
* Support the evaluation and improvement of documentation tools, platforms, and publishing processes.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Five or more years of experience in technical writing, preferably within a software, SaaS, technology, or enterprise solutions environment.
* Demonstrated experience creating software and product documentation for a range of audiences.
* Strong ability to understand complex systems, workflows, and technical concepts.
* Excellent written English, editing, proofreading, and information\-architecture skills.
* Experience collaborating with developers, product managers, consultants, and other technical subject matter experts.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Experience working within an agile product\-development or software\-release environment.
* Ability to work independently, ask effective questions, and identify missing or unclear information.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and consistency.
* Experience using documentation, content\-management, collaboration, and version\-control tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience documenting enterprise business applications, cloud platforms, integrations, APIs, or configurable software solutions.
* Familiarity with structured authoring, content reuse, documentation\-as\-code, or single\-source publishing.
* Experience with tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, Git, Markdown, MadCap Flare, Paligo, or similar platforms.
* Experience creating diagrams, process flows, screenshots, or instructional media.
* Understanding of user experience, accessibility, and content\-design principles.
* Experience developing or governing documentation standards across multiple teams or products.


**Key Competencies**
* Clear and concise communication
* Technical curiosity and learning agility
* Stakeholder collaboration
* Content organization and information architecture
* Editorial judgment and attention to detail
* Planning and prioritization
* Ownership and accountability
* Continuous improvement
* User\-focused thinking

As a Business Analyst, you will serve as the essential link between our operational data and daily decision\-making. * Data Integrity: Ensure our reporting structures are accurate and proactive, identifying trends early so the team can adjust and improve operational precision.

description:
**Overview**

 The Global Customer Success (GCS) organization, an organization within CE\&S, is leading the effort to enable customer success on the Microsoft Cloud by harnessing leading, AI\-powered capabilities and human expertise to deliver innovation solutions that accelerate business value, drive operational excellence and nurture long term loyalty.
   

  

 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to help design and deliver
 **secure, resilient solutions**

 **repeatable security focused solutions**

**Qualifications**

 In addition

title: Technical Onboarding Engineer
description:
**About Neo4j**
 Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Neo4j Technical Onboarding Engineers play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. As a Technical Onboarding Engineer, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production\-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
   

  

 Sitting at the heart of our customer\-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (e.g., Solution Architect, Solution Engineer, Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
* Hands\-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
* Hands\-on experience and technical proficiency in SQL or NoSQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
* Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with ETL/CDC platforms and data ingestion.
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk).
* Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.


**Responsibilities**
* Drive customer value by translating complex business requirements into tailored technical solutions that solve core business challenges and accelerate cloud adoption.
* Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
* Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self\-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption\-at\-rest protocols, and enforce least\-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best\-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high\-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next\-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
* Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.

 Microsoft Azure Storage is a highly distributed, massively scalable, and ubiquitously accessible cloud storage platform.  You will be part of the Global Technology organization and report to the Engineering Manager. On a daily basis, you will collaborate with peer software engineers, product managers, and architects on product teams to achieve business objectives. Additionally, you will engage with other Global Technology teams to align on both organizational and individual development goals.
   

  

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are seeking a ambitious Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. You’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining both front\-end and back\-end applications, ensuring seamless and scalable experiences for users. You will play a critical role in building robust features, maintaining system performance, and collaborating across teams to deliver high\-quality cloud native software solutions. If you thrive in a collaborative environment, are energized by innovative technology, and excel at problem\-solving, this role may be a great fit for you.
   

  

**Key Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 1\+ years\*\* of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer or in a similar role.
* Hands on Exposure on Front\-End Skills in React or similar technologies. Hands on Exposure on in server\-side programming languages such as Node.js, Python or similar.
* Database Expertise: Experience NoSQL databases.
* API Development: Hands on exposure to designing and consuming RESTful APIs and web services.
* Cloud Technologies: Familiarity with cloud platforms preferably AWS, including experience with serverless architectures and cloud\-native development. Version Control:
* Proficient with Git, GitHub, or similar version control tools. Testing Frameworks: Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test\-driven development (TDD).
* Problem\-Solving: Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
* Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work well in a team\-oriented, fast\-paced environment.
* Bonus Skills: Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab), containerization technologies like Docker, or familiarity with microservices architecture.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with ambiguity.


**What You’ll Work On**
* Design \& Develop: Build, test, and maintain scalable web applications and services.
* Work on both front\-end and back\-end development to deliver end\-to\-end functionality.
* Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define requirements, technical specifications, and deliver quality software.
* Front\-End Development: Implement dynamic, responsive, and user\-friendly web interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks ( React).
* Back\-End Development: Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and backend services using technologies like Node.js, Python or similar. Database Management: Develop NoSQL databases, ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval.

* CI/CD Integration: Integrate with and maintain continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for seamless software delivery.
* Agile Methodologies: Participate in Agile processes, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Meet The Team**
 Join the
 **Cisco IIoT team** 
 to work on product development for industrial switching and routing solutions that transform industrial operations. The team builds secure, scalable technologies across industrial networking, edge computing, and IoT security, helping customers in manufacturing, energy, transportation, and smart cities improve efficiency through real\-time insights. Cisco offers software engineers a unique experience that blends the scale and resources of a global organization with a startup\-like culture, strong collaboration, and broad growth opportunities.
   

  

 We are seeking a Systems Engineer with experience in wireless communication systems, cellular networking, and emerging LEO satellite technologies. You will be responsible for evaluating, integrating, and validating satellite\-enabled connectivity solutions, including Starlink\-based wireless backhaul and Direct\-to\-Cell architectures.
   

  

**As a System Engineer, Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Designing and developing tools to test the functionality of Cisco products, ensuring quality and stability from a system/solution perspective that simulates customer environments with IIoT deployments
* Creating documentation (Cisco Validated Profiles) for various end\-to\-end solutions.
* Addressing customer issues related to Industrial IoT (IIoT) products, reproducing problems in\-house for root cause analysis, and driving resolution.
* Collaborating with local and remote teams to review Product Requirements Documents, Software Functional and Design Specifications, and other relevant documentation to extract test requirements and provide feedback for testability and system automation design/execution.
* Enhancing test efficiency and effectiveness by analyzing customer\-found issues and applying appropriate testing approaches, technologies, tools, and innovations.
* Leveraging Machine Learning (MI) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques to improve test automation and manual testing processes.
* Supporting the test team in expanding their knowledge of testing technologies and networking by staying updated with the latest industry developments.
* Contributing to the department’s knowledge retention by systematically archiving meaningful documentation and equipment.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* You have 8\+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance with a focus on test automation with hands on experience in building and maintaining test suites.
* Strong understanding of LEO (Low Earth Orbit) satellite communication systems and satellite network architectures.
* Knowledge of Starlink services, user terminals, gateways, and satellite\-based internet connectivity.
* Experience with cellular technologies including LTE, 5G NR, cellular gateways, and SIM\-based connectivity solutions.
* Understanding of wireless backhaul architectures using satellite and cellular networks.
* Experience with IP networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, NAT, DNS, and VPN technologies.
* Knowledge of Ethernet\-based network integration and gateway validation.
* Familiarity with system\-level integration, verification, and validation methodologies.
* You have deeper networking knowledge with the hands\-on experience on routers/switches.
* You leverage AI/ML tools for network infrastructure support and to drive productivity improvements.
* You have experience in conducting Performance and Scale testing of newer platforms and features


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in programming languages such as Python or any similar languages.
* Experience testing or integrating Starlink\-based connectivity solutions.
* Experience with industrial routers, IoT gateways, or edge computing platforms.
* You leverage AI/ML tools for network infrastructure support and to drive productivity improvements.
* Familiarity with network emulators, traffic generators, and cellular test environments.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in embedded systems or firmware development.
* Experience in embedded software or firmware development in C or C\+\+.
* Experience in bringing up bare\-metal environments on SoCs.
* Experience in performing firmware debugging on silicon and using debugging tools (e.g., TRACE32 or OpenOCD).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in using emulation platforms for firmware enablement, validation, and debug.
* Experience with ARM and RISC\-V architectures.
* Experience in industry standard software development practices and agile methodologies.
* Understanding of SoC architecture and interfaces (e.g., Advanced Extensible Interface (AXI), Double Data Rate (DDR), Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe), etc.).


**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop embedded firmware, bare metal tests and low\-level debug tools for pre and post\-silicon validation of SoCs. Exercise these capabilities on emulation, simulation and silicon platforms.
* Co\-work with architecture, design and verification teams and enable hardware\-software co\-design.
* Engage with silicon design teams at a very early stage and drive integration validation and firmware features enablement as the silicon development progresses.
* Work closely with post\-silicon and platform hardware teams to ensure silicon enablement and support silicon debugs.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
**Job function:**
**Design, develop, test and support Zephyr RTOS for ARM and RISC\-V in Qualcomm SoCs.** 
**As a Core Platform Kernel software engineer, you will be part of a team of software engineers who are passionate about kernel level programming with keen attention to write high performance code for resource\-constrained processors.**
**We are continually enhancing the OS to support new SoC features, enhance power savings features, enhance security and provide new OS functionality to meet the demands of our customers.**
**Skills/experience**
**1\-3 years of Software Engineering or related work experience; Strong analytical, mathematical and debugging skills 1\-3 years experience with Programming Language such as C, Python; pointers, data structures (e.g. linked list, trees, sorting)**
**1\+ years experience working with Assembly language. 1\+ years experience working on software for RISC\-V or ARM processors; Hardware and architectural knowledge / experience (Processor Architecture, Cache, interrupts, Memory barriers, Strong ordering, etc.)**
**1\+ years experience using Emulator, simulator environment, LLDB/JTAG debuggers / profilers 1\+ years experience working on real time operating systems for embedded systems;** 
**Thorough RTOS knowledge and experience (Mutex, spinlocks, Queues, Signaling, Events, Deferred function calls \& Callbacks, Multi\-thread \& Multi\-process environments, Concurrency Scenarios, etc.)**
**Responsibilities**
**RTOS development, LLDB/Debugger development, Safe RTOS development**
**Education Requirements**
**B.Tech. or M.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent engineering**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

title: Software engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Software engineer
   

  

**Overview**
 This role operates within a globally distributed delivery model, partnering closely with established onshore teams to deliver and maintain high\-availability, mission\-critical systems.
   

  

 The successful candidate will contribute to the ongoing evolution and stability of key payment platforms within a scaled Agile (SAFe) environment.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**The Software Engineer Will Be Responsible For**
* Agile Delivery (SAFe Framework): Working within an established Scrum team aligned to SAFe, contributing to sprint planning, execution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Distributed Team Collaboration: Collaborating closely with onshore engineering teams to deliver features, resolve defects, and ensure seamless integration across the delivery lifecycle.
* Application Development \& Maintenance: Designing, developing, and maintaining solutions across a multi\-technology stack.
* Production Support \& Reliability: Supporting critical live systems, ensuring performance, resilience, and adherence to enterprise standards and controls.
* Continuous Improvement: Contributing to engineering best practices, automation, and process enhancements to improve delivery efficiency and quality.


**All About You**
 We are looking for a technically strong and collaborative Software Engineer who thrives in a complex, enterprise\-scale environment.
   

  

**Key Requirements Include**
* Experience with Java\-based backend development
* Exposure to Spring\-Boot framework
* Knowledge of TDD and BDD testing frameworks (JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, etc.)
* Knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular and JavaScript
* Familiarity with SQL scripting and data handling
* Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies, ideally within SAFe
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ownership mindset
* Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams


**Desirable Experience**
* Exposure to Devops tooling
* Experience with relational databases (Oracle)
* Knowledge of REST, Messaging and Event Driven frameworks/solutions


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences. As a part of team of developers, you will deliver technology stack, using strong analytical and problem solving skills to understand the business requirements and deliver quality solutions.

* Java 17/21

* Git
