**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Includes**
* Karate
* Kotlin
* JMeter/Gatling
* Testing framework pyramid
* JIRA , Confluence


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Being a part of MillerKnoll means being a part of something larger than your work team, or even your brand. We are redefining modern for the 21st century. And our success allows MillerKnoll to support causes that align with our values, so we can build a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful future for everyone.
   

  

 Role: Senior Application Developer \- .Net
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking to hire a .Net application developer, with excellent technical and
   

  

 communication skills, to effectively collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to understand their needs and develop functionality and enhancements for the ERP or web \& windows application work. In his/her day\-to\-day operations, the Application Developer will also field and resolve usage issues and perform other duties as assigned, that align with the role’s responsibilities and are required for the business.
   

  

 This role provides an opportunity to join our Dealer Tools development team. While focused on professional development and hands\-on training with .NET and Angular this position will have exposure to creating world class applications for our dealer network. This role transcends organizational and geographical boundaries as it aims to support and enable the various divisions of the Herman Miller business group across the globe. The ideal candidate should

**Responsibilities**
* Support internal and external customers by developing, testing, and deploying


 automation solutions using Visual Studio, VS Code, and Microsoft SQL Server in an AWS Environment and local Environment.
   

  

* Work with technical / business analysts to ensure that specifications are designed effectively to support stable and efficient workflows.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Kiran Jewels India is hiring a Full Stack Developer to build and run the software that runs our business.
 



 We are a jewelry manufacturing company with an in\-house product team. We do not buy off\-the\-shelf tools and bend our operations around them. We build our own, covering inventory, retail operations, HR, and AI\-assisted workflows. Everything you write goes into production and gets used by real teams every day. You will not hand your code to a separate ops team. You build it, you ship it, you keep it running.
 



**What you will do** 



* Build and ship web applications end to end, from data model to interface
* Design relational schemas, write secure REST APIs, and own the auth layer
* Develop responsive, performant frontends in a modern component framework
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines, from commit through automated testing to deploy
* Handle deployment, environment configuration, logging, monitoring, and incident response
* Enforce data security practices across the stack, from database to browser
* Integrate LLM APIs into real product features such as search, extraction, and assisted data entry
* Sit with operations, stock, and HR teams to turn messy real\-world workflows into working software



**Application development** 



* A modern JavaScript frontend framework, React preferred, with solid TypeScript fundamentals
* A backend language and framework, Python or Node based
* REST API design, versioning, error handling, and clear API contracts
* Relational database design, indexing, migrations, and query optimisation, PostgreSQL or MySQL
* Caching and background job processing



**Authentication and access control** 



* Session and token\-based auth, JWT lifecycle, refresh token rotation, and secure logout
* Password hashing and credential storage done correctly, never in plaintext, never reversible
* Role\-based access control and permission modelling for multi\-role internal systems
* Multi\-factor authentication and SSO or OAuth integration
* Protecting every endpoint, not just the login screen, and enforcing authorisation server side



**Data security** 



* Encryption in transit and at rest, TLS configuration, and certificate management
* Secrets management, environment separation, and never committing credentials to a repository
* Input validation, parameterised queries, and defence against SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF
* Rate limiting, request throttling, and abuse protection on public\-facing endpoints
* Audit logging, access trails, and the ability to answer who changed what and when
* Secure file upload and storage handling, including access\-controlled object storage
* Dependency scanning and timely patching of known vulnerabilities
* Backup strategy, restore testing, and data retention discipline
* Awareness of India's DPDP Act obligations around personal and employee data



**CI/CD** 



* Git branching strategy, pull requests, and code review as normal practice
* Automated pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent
* Automated testing in the pipeline, unit and integration, with linting and type checks as gates
* Build artifacts, containerisation with Docker, and reproducible builds
* Separate development, staging, and production environments with promotion between them
* Database migration handling as part of deploy, not as a manual afterthought
* Rollback strategy and safe release practices



**Deployment and operations** 



* Deploying to cloud infrastructure or self\-managed servers, comfortable on Linux
* Reverse proxy and web server configuration, Nginx or similar
* Container orchestration basics
* Application monitoring, structured logging, error tracking, and uptime alerting
* Performance profiling and debugging issues in a live environment
* Basic infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration management



**On AI tooling** 




**We expect you to use AI coding assistants and use them well. That means reviewing, refactoring, and taking responsibility for what they produce. Our only rule is that you ship code you can explain and defend, especially anything touching auth or data security.** 




**Who this suits** 



* 1 to 3 years of full stack experience, or project work that clearly demonstrates the same ability
* Someone who treats security and reliability as part of the build, not a phase at the end
* Someone who takes ownership, works independently, and communicates clearly about progress and blockers
* Degree optional. Shipped work counts more.



**Why this role** 



* **Most developer jobs at this level mean one ticket, one screen, one small corner of a large codebase. Here you own systems outright, including how they are secured and how they are deployed. You will touch inventory, retail, HR, and AI tooling within your first year, and you will get direct mentorship on architecture, security, and system design along the way.**

title: Staff Facilitator & Training Coordinator
description:
**Overview**
------------


The Facilitator \& Training Coordinator is a high\-impact, shared\-skill role that unifies live learning delivery and operational coordination into a single integrated position. You will facilitate ILT, VILT, and blended learning sessions that drive measurable behavior change; own end\-to\-end logistics, LMS administration, scheduling, and learner communications; and track Kirkpatrick L1–L2 data to fuel continuous improvement. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity — equally energized by facilitating a dynamic virtual classroom and by building a clean tracking spreadsheet the next morning. They hold two truths simultaneously: great facilitation is a craft requiring preparation, presence, and adaptability; great coordination is a discipline requiring precision, proactivity, and follow\-through. Reports to the Facilitation Manager.

 **Responsibilities**

*Facilitation \& Learning Delivery*

* Deliver ILT and VILT sessions on customer service, product knowledge, communication skills, systems navigation, and role\-specific content across new hire onboarding, upskilling, and continuous learning programs
* Create an inclusive, participatory learning environment grounded in adult learning principles; use role plays, case studies, call simulations, and scenario\-based exercises (learners doing 80%, facilitator guiding 20%)
* Facilitate nesting and on\-the\-job practice with coaching, feedback, and structured debriefs before learners are released to production
* Adjust delivery in real time based on group energy and comprehension signals; provide 1:1 and small\-group coaching for learners needing reinforcement
* Partner with QA and Operations to align content with current KPIs, quality benchmarks, and performance standards

*Training Coordination \& Operations*

* Own end\-to\-end scheduling of sessions — calendar setup, learner invitations, rescheduling, cancellations; serve as day\-of logistics lead (virtual session setup, breakout rooms, real\-time issue resolution)
* Manage learner enrollment, waitlists, completions, and certifications in the LMS; maintain accurate, audit\-ready records and distribute compliance reports
* Prepare and version\-control training materials, workbooks, facilitator guides, and job aids; coordinate supplies, vendors, and invoicing
* Draft pre\-training communications, reminders, pre\-work instructions, and post\-training follow\-ups; distribute evaluation surveys within 24 hours of session close

*Data, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement*

  

* Track and report attendance, no\-show rates, completions, learner satisfaction (L1\), and post\-training assessment results (L2\) on a weekly/monthly cadence
* Identify patterns (scheduling conflicts, low\-completion cohorts, engagement trends) and proactively surface insights; maintain training calendars, trackers, and dashboards
* Participate in post\-session debriefs and contribute to the Facilitator Community of Practice

 **Qualifications**

*Required*

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in HR, Education, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
* 3–5 years facilitating training in contact center, customer service, financial services, or similar environments, with demonstrated success in blended learning (ILT, VILT, eLearning)
* 1–3 years of training coordination, learning operations, HR administration, or event/program management
* Experience with at least one enterprise LMS (Workday Learning, Docebo, Cornerstone OnDemand, or equivalent)
* Proficiency with virtual platforms (Zoom, Teams, Webex, Google Meet) and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication; comfort compiling and presenting clean, accurate metrics

*Preferred*

  

* Certifications: ATD (CPTD/APTD), Kirkpatrick Four Levels®, ICF, or equivalent
* Familiarity with financial services, tax, accounting, or small business software (QuickBooks, Intuit product suite)
* Exposure to adult learning principles (Knowles), ADDIE/SAM, and Kirkpatrick L1–L4 evaluation
* Coaching background with struggling/resistant learners; experience with Smartsheet, Asana, or Jira

  

Footer
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Identity Specialist
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  

Who Are We?
  
  

For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  

Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  

A Day in the Life of Identity Specialist!
  
  

This role of Identity Specialist is responsible for the comprehensive implementation and operational management of our identity and access management solutions, with a primary focus on ensuring robust identity protection across the enterprise, involving leading the transformation and optimization of critical identity infrastructure, collaborating with security and IT teams, and driving the adoption of best practices to secure user access and privileged accounts.
  
  

In this role, You will..
  
  

**Be responsible for the following:**  

* Lead the architecture, implementation, and administration of core identity services including Active Directory (AD) and Entra ID (Azure AD), ensuring high availability, security, and performance.
* Manage the Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) lifecycle, including certificate issuance, revocation, and integration with various enterprise applications and systems.
* Design, deploy, and maintain privileged access management (PAM) solutions, specifically CyberArk, to safeguard sensitive credentials and manage elevated access efficiently.
* Implement and manage Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) strategies and solutions, enhancing security for both on\-premises and cloud\-based resources.
* Develop and enforce robust account management processes, including provisioning, de\-provisioning, and regular access reviews, to align with security policies and compliance requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for all Identity and Access Management (IAM) related technologies and initiatives, providing guidance and support to various IT and business units.
* Collaborate closely with Cyber Security, and other IT teams to integrate identity solutions, respond to security incidents, and maintain a strong security posture.
* Strategize, plan, and execute projects related to identity system enhancements, upgrades, and integrations from conception to successful Go\-live, ensuring a smooth transition into operations.
* Monitor and report on the health, performance, and security of identity infrastructure and services, ensuring service delivery meets defined SLAs and business requirements.


What are we looking for?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related study, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with a focus on identity protection, privileged access management, and directory services in large enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated expert\-level proficiency with Active Directory (AD), Entra ID (Azure AD), and their associated services (e.g., federation, synchronization).
* In\-depth hands\-on experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) management and certificate lifecycle.
* Proven experience in implementing, configuring, and managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, specifically CyberArk.
* Strong understanding and practical experience with Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) technologies and deployment strategies.
* Familiarity with identity governance principles, access reviews, and compliance frameworks.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across diverse teams and communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated effective oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strategic thinking with a proactive, results\-oriented approach and a passion for innovation in identity security.


Nice to Have
  
  

* Preferable: Experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools for reporting, dashboard creation, and analytics related to identity data and security metrics.


What’s In It for You?
  
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future\-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings \- personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long\-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment


**Good to know:** The Recruitment Process
  
  

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview
* Interview with the hiring manager


We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  

Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  

A Day in the Life of SecOps Manager!
  
  

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong SecOps Manager to strengthen the cybersecurity posture of our server, virtual machine, cloud workload, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  
  

Reporting to the CSD Zone Lead, the SecOps Manager will lead security operations, vulnerability remediation, audit\-action tracking, cloud\-security posture management, and resilience activities across on\-premise and multi\-cloud environments.
  
  

You will work closely with Infrastructure, Cloud, Applications, IT Operations, Global Cyber Security, managed\-service providers, and business stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity risks are identified, prioritised, remediated, and clearly reported.
  
  

In this role, You will.
  
  

**Be responsible for the following:**  

Security Operations \& Risk Mitigation
  
* Lead security operations for servers, virtual machines, cloud workloads, and associated infrastructure services.
* Oversee the effectiveness and coverage of security technologies such as Tanium, server EDR, anti\-malware, CWPP, vulnerability\-management, and security\-monitoring tools.
* Drive the remediation of vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, unsupported technologies, and security\-control gaps.
* Define and track SecOps KPIs and KRIs, including vulnerability ageing, patch compliance, workload\-security coverage, remediation timelines, and risk exceptions.
* Prepare operational dashboards and risk reports for cybersecurity governance and leadership teams.


Vulnerability, Patch \& Obsolescence Management
  
* Own the end\-to\-end vulnerability\-management lifecycle for servers, VMs, infrastructure platforms, and cloud workloads.
* Coordinate vulnerability identification, triage, prioritisation, remediation planning, exception management, validation, and closure.
* Orchestrate lifecycle patching across on\-premise, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments.
* Track and manage technology\-obsolescence risks related to operating systems, middleware, databases, runtimes, virtualization platforms, and infrastructure components.
* Apply a risk\-based approach considering severity, exploitability, asset criticality, business impact, and external exposure.


Cloud Security
  
* Manage cloud\-security posture and remediation activities across AliCloud ,Azure, GCP and AWS environments.
* Demonstrate hands\-on experience with AliCloud technologies and security controls, including ECS, VPC, RAM, security groups, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and cloud\-configuration security.
* Coordinate remediation of CSPM findings and cloud misconfigurations.
* Partner with Cloud and Platform teams to improve identity controls, network segmentation, encryption, logging, monitoring, security baselines, and workload hardening.
* Ensure server, VM, cloud workload, and security\-relevant configuration information is complete and accurate in the CMDB.


Security Audit Tracking \& Mitigation
  
* Manage the tracking and remediation of findings from internal and external audits, cybersecurity assessments, penetration tests, cloud\-security reviews, compliance reviews, and operational\-risk assessments.
* Maintain a central audit\-action tracker covering action owner, due date, remediation evidence, risk status, and escalation requirements.
* Validate evidence before closure and ensure actions address the root cause of the identified control gap.
* Report on open, overdue, high\-risk, and recurring audit findings, highlighting trends and required management decisions.


DRP \& Resilience Management
  
* Own and maintain the annual Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP) calendar.
* Coordinate DRP exercises, recovery tests, failover tests, tabletop exercises, evidence collection, lessons learned, and remediation follow\-up.
* Work with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, and Business Continuity teams to improve recovery readiness, backup controls, resilience, and operational continuity.
* Ensure gaps identified during DRP tests are tracked, assigned, and closed within agreed timelines.


On\-Demand Cybersecurity Initiatives
  
* Lead or support targeted cybersecurity initiatives based on business, audit, technology, regulatory, or risk requirements.
* Typical initiatives may include Java compliance, cyber\-process improvement, server hardening, cloud\-security remediation, security\-tool onboarding, CMDB improvement, privileged\-access remediation, audit remediation, and cloud\-migration security assessments.
* Manage action plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, stakeholder communication, and delivery reporting.


AI, Automation \& Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Experience applying automation and AI\-enabled capabilities to improve cybersecurity operations, such as vulnerability prioritisation, alert enrichment, remediation tracking, audit\-evidence collection, compliance reporting, and security\-dashboard automation.
* Understanding of responsible use of AI in security operations, including validation of AI\-generated outputs, data protection, access controls, traceability, and human oversight for risk\-based decisions.
* Practical experience with automation and orchestration tools, scripting, APIs, or workflow platforms to reduce manual operational activities and improve remediation speed and consistency.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security practices, including secure provisioning, configuration validation, policy\-as\-code, secrets management, version control, and automated compliance checks.
* Experience reviewing or supporting IaC technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, ARM templates, Bicep, Alibaba Cloud Resource Orchestration Service (ROS), or equivalent tools.


What are we looking for?
  
  

Education \& Experience
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity operations, server security, cloud security, vulnerability management, IT infrastructure security, audit remediation, or IT risk.
* Demonstrated experience managing security for servers, virtual machines, cloud workloads, and hybrid infrastructure.
* Proven experience with vulnerability remediation, patch\-management coordination, audit tracking, and security\-control reporting.
* Experience in enterprise\-scale, geographically distributed, or managed\-services environments is preferred.


Certifications Candidates should hold at least one relevant cybersecurity or cloud\-security certification, such as:
  
* CISM, CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security\+
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate
* AWS Certified Security \- Specialty
* Relevant Ali Cloud certification, preferably in cloud architecture, cloud security, or cloud operations


Technical Skills
  
* Strong knowledge of server, VM, and cloud\-workload security.
* Experience with vulnerability management, patching, secure configuration, CSPM, CWPP, CMDB, audit remediation, and DRP testing.
* Working knowledge of AliCloud, including ECS, VPC, RAM, security groups, logging, monitoring, and cloud\-security practices.
* Familiarity with Azure and AWS cloud\-security controls.
* Exposure to tools such as Tanium, Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender for Cloud/Servers, CrowdStrike, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Benchmarks, ITIL, and cloud\-security best practices is desirable.


Nice to Have
  
  

* Relevant Ali Cloud certification, preferably in cloud architecture, cloud security, or cloud operations


What’s In It for You?
  
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future\-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings \- personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long\-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**

  

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast\-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.

  

As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future\-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting\-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.

 **About The Role**

  

We are looking for an experienced and detail\-oriented HR Generalist to manage end\-to\-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle. The ideal candidate will be responsible for onboarding, employee data management, payroll coordination, leave administration, compliance, and HR audits. This role requires strong stakeholder management skills and hands\-on experience with HR systems, preferably Workday

 **What You’ll Do**

 **1\. Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle Management**

  

* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding processes, including documentation, background verification, and induction.
* Ensure a seamless joining experience for new employees.
* Coordinate system access and required onboarding formalities.
* Maintain accurate employee records throughout the employee lifecycle.

 **2\. Exit Management**

  

* Handle resignation processes and employee exit formalities.
* Conduct exit interviews and maintain exit\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with payroll for timely processing of full and final settlements.
* Ensure proper closure of employee records and system access.

 **3\. HR Operations \& Workday Management**

  

* Manage and maintain employee data in Workday.
* Ensure data accuracy, system updates, and record maintenance.
* Generate HR reports and support dashboard requirements.
* Assist in HR system audits and process improvements.

 **4\. Absence \& Leave Management**

  

* Administer employee leave and attendance records.
* Ensure compliance with company leave policies.
* Address employee queries related to leave, attendance, and absence management.
* Maintain accurate leave balances and records.

 **5\. Payroll Coordination**

  

* Collaborate closely with the payroll team to provide monthly payroll inputs.
* Validate attendance, leave, and employee movement data.
* Ensure payroll information is accurate and submitted within deadlines.
* Support payroll audits and compliance activities.

 **6\. HR Audits \& Compliance**

  

* Support internal and external HR audits.
* Maintain HR documentation and records in line with company policies and statutory requirements.
* Assist in the preparation, review, and updating of HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and organizational standards.

 **Unleash your potential**

  

To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in HR Operations or HR Generalist roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday or other HRMS platforms.

description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 0 to 5 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description:** 




 SplashData is a leading provider of security and productivity software applications for mobile professionals, businesses, and enterprise customers. The company’s flagship product, SplashID, has been the \#1 cross\-platform password manager for over a decade. SplashID is available on iOS, Android, Windows, Mac OS, and via the web, making it accessible across devices and platforms. Team members contribute to products that help users securely manage sensitive information while improving efficiency and digital safety.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 





 We are seeking a motivated Quality Engineer to join our team in Pune. In this role, your primary focus will be on ensuring the reliability, usability, and performance of our core suite of applications. You will be responsible for defining test strategies, executing manual test cases, and developing automated test scripts using modern testing frameworks.
 





 In this role, you will have the opportunity to deep\-dive into cross\-platform system testing and the development of sophisticated automated test frameworks. You will be instrumental in ensuring application reliability and performance across diverse environments, while receiving dedicated mentorship and support to master the nuances of testing legacy systems.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Manual Testing** 

 : Conduct thorough manual exploratory and functional testing across mobile, desktop, and web applications to identify defects and ensure a seamless user experience.
* **Automation Testing** 

 : Build, maintain, and scale automated test suites for our Flutter\-based applications to increase testing efficiency and coverage.
* **Legacy Application Testing** 

 : Develop a deep understanding of our legacy native applications to establish and maintain robust automated testing processes for long\-term stability.
* **Test Planning \& Bug Tracking** 

 : Create detailed test plans and cases, and manage the full defect lifecycle using tracking tools like JIRA to ensure all issues are resolved before release.
* **Collaboration** 

 : Work closely with the engineering manager, software engineers, quality engineers, UI/UX designers, and backend engineers to deliver clean user experiences.
* **Requirement Analysis** 

 : Participate in requirement analysis to ensure testability and clarity of project specifications.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* **Experience** 

 : 1–3 years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong emphasis on both manual and automated testing of web, mobile and desktop applications.
* **Networking** 

 : Strong understanding of HTTP protocols, JSON parsing, and experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman) and network monitoring to validate API responses and network traffic.
* **Testing Mindset** 

 : Experience writing automated unit and integration tests.
* **Tooling** 

 : Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and industry\-standard debugging tools and hands\-on experience using profiling resources like Flutter DevTools, Xcode, and Android Studio to diagnose performance issues and memory leaks. Experience with cross\-browser and cross\-device testing platforms like BrowserStack.
* **Adaptability** 

 : A strong willingness to learn, explore, and establish automated testing protocols for older, legacy codebases (Objective\-C, Java, C\#/.NET), with provided team support.
* **Work Authorization \& Presence** 

 : Must be located in or willing to relocate to Pune and be able to work from our Pune office at least 2 days a week.



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Advanced experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Flutter Driver, Appium, Selenium, XCUITest).
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline integration for automated testing.
* Familiarity with performance testing metrics and monitoring tools for production stability.
* Experience with agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enhance development and testing productivity.



  





**Location:** 





 Pune, India (Hybrid role: minimum of 2 days per week in\-office)
 




  






 Candidates available to join immediately will be given priority.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled and motivated **Network Engineer** to support, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot the organization's network infrastructure. **About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.

description:
Are you someone who loves the thrill of a good pitch and the satisfaction of closing a deal? Creativepoint is looking for driven, people\-oriented individuals to join our growth team and help expand our client base across industries. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants hands\-on exposure to sales, client relationship management, and the fast\-paced world of digital marketing.

**Your Day\-to\-Day**

* Actively hunt for new business opportunities by researching and identifying potential clients across various industries
* Pitch tailored digital marketing solutions — SEO, social media, paid advertising, web services \- based on each client's specific needs and goals
* Build long\-term relationships with prospects through regular calls, in\-person meetings, and thoughtful follow\-ups
* Liaise closely with internal delivery and marketing teams to ensure every proposal is accurate, realistic, and compelling
* Close deals directly when possible, or qualify and hand off promising leads to senior BD staff for further nurturing
* Maintain a strong, consistently updated sales pipeline using our CRM system
* Represent Creativepoint at industry events, client meetings, and networking opportunities to build the brand's presence
* Stay updated on digital marketing trends to speak knowledgeably and confidently with prospective clients

**Ideal Candidate**

* Graduate or diploma holder from any academic stream
* Excellent communicator — confident, personable, and able to build rapport quickly
* Fluent Tamil speaker with working knowledge of English (spoken and written)
* A sales\-driven mindset with genuine curiosity about business and client relationships
* Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply — we value attitude and willingness to learn over prior experience
* Comfortable using Excel, email, and CRM systems for day\-to\-day reporting and tracking
* Open to traveling locally for client meetings and events as needed

**Why This Role Could Be a Great Fit**

* You'll get real ownership over your own client pipeline from day one — no micromanagement, just support when you need it
* Structured, hands\-on training in sales techniques, negotiation, and digital marketing fundamentals
* Exposure to a wide variety of businesses, helping you build a versatile professional network early in your career
* A clear, merit\-based promotion path toward Senior BDE and BD Manager roles
* A friendly, collaborative team culture where questions are welcomed and growth is genuinely encouraged

**Perks \& Benefits**

* Paid time off
* Uncapped performance\-based incentives
* Clear career progression roadmap
* Exposure to diverse industries and client types

* Work in a hospitality\-driven, nature\-inspired environment

**About Firgun**

Firgun is a hospitality brand built on meaningful experiences, genuine connections, and thoughtful service. At Firgun Chapter Shoja, every team member contributes towards creating memorable stays for guests visiting the mountains. We believe cleanliness, attention to detail, and care are fundamental to delivering exceptional hospitality.

**Role Purpose**

The Housekeeper is responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation across guest rooms, washrooms, common areas, and staff spaces. The role goes beyond cleaning—it ensures every guest walks into a fresh, comfortable, and welcoming environment.

**Key ResponsibilitiesGuest Room Maintenance**

* Clean and prepare guest rooms before every check\-in.
* Change bed linen, towels, and replenish guest amenities.
* Ensure bathrooms are spotless and fully stocked.
* Inspect rooms for maintenance issues and report them immediately.
* Maintain room presentation according to Firgun standards.

**Common Area Upkeep**

* Keep the reception, café, corridors, terraces, washrooms, and outdoor areas clean.
* Sweep, mop, dust, and sanitize all public areas regularly.
* Ensure waste bins are emptied and cleaned throughout the day.

**Laundry Management**

* Collect, sort, wash, dry, fold, and organize linen and towels.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of the laundry area.
* Report damaged linen or shortages.

**Inventory \& Supplies**

* Maintain housekeeping inventory and cleaning supplies.
* Inform the reporting manager before stock levels run low.
* Ensure proper storage and responsible usage of cleaning materials.

**Guest Support**

* Respond politely to guest housekeeping requests.
* Coordinate with the Front Office and Property Manager regarding room readiness.
* Maintain guest privacy and confidentiality at all times.

**Hygiene \& Safety**

* Use cleaning chemicals safely and responsibly.
* Report any hazards, damages, or safety concerns immediately.

title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operations Tech
   

  

 This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advanced data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

 Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:
   

  

* Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
* Deep diving into Linux server issues
* XEN service virtualization troubleshooting


 Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical
   

  

* Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems \& Network
* Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
* Participate in Data Center power \& cooling events


 Operations: Meet 24x7 On\-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.
   

  

* Install \& configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
* Triage \& resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
* Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
* Physical replacement of server and network device parts
* Ensure correct rotation of parts \& spares
* Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
* Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
* Interact with third party vendors \& contractors
* Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency


**Project Management**
* Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid\-scale projects
* Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
* Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India


 Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues
   

  

 Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* 1\+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies

title: Branch Executive
description:
**SALES OFFICER — JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Sales Officer — Gold Finance**

**Reports To:** Branch Manager / Assistant Branch Manager

**Supervises:** N/A — Individual Contributor

**Location:** Branch\-based with active field duty — local market coverage, doorstep visits, and lead follow\-up in the branch catchment area

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Sales Officer is the frontline growth engine of the KGF branch — responsible for generating new gold loan customers, converting leads, driving disbursement volumes, and deepening relationships with existing customers for renewals and top\-ups. The SO operates both at the counter and in the field — visiting markets, households, and business establishments to create awareness and acquire customers. The role demands a proactive, self\-driven personality with strong local market knowledge, persuasion skills, and a genuine ability to build lasting customer trust on behalf of the KGF brand.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Lead Generation \& New Customer Acquisition**

* Generate new gold loan leads through field visits — markets, residential areas, commercial hubs — within the branch catchment.
* Conduct door\-to\-door campaigns and community events to build brand awareness and attract first\-time gold loan customers.
* Identify and target key customer segments — micro\-entrepreneurs, traders, farmers, homemakers, and self\-employed individuals.
* Build and maintain a personal lead pipeline — minimum lead targets to be met weekly as set by BM.
* Follow up on all assigned leads from the telecalling team within 24 hours — no lead left uncontacted beyond one business day.
* Collect customer references from every satisfied borrower and convert referrals into active loan accounts.
* Track lead\-to\-disbursement conversion rate; identify drop\-off points and report to BM with corrective action plan.

**B. Disbursement Target Achievement**

* Own individual monthly disbursement target — plan weekly activity to ensure on\-track achievement at all times.
* Coordinate with counter staff and ABM to ensure customer brought to branch is processed and disbursed same day.
* Drive renewal disbursements — proactively contact customers whose loans are due for renewal before the loan expiry date.
* Promote top\-up loans to customers with good repayment history — identify eligible accounts from ABM\-shared list.
* Submit daily disbursement activity report to BM — leads met, customers visited, disbursements achieved, pipeline for tomorrow.
* Participate in morning briefing with full knowledge of the day's target and plan of action.

**C. Field Activity \& Market Coverage**

* Execute daily field beat plan — minimum number of customer visits and prospect contacts as set by BM.
* Cover assigned micro\-market zones systematically — no repeated coverage of same area while leaving other zones unvisited.
* Attend local events, mandis, weekly markets, and business associations to represent KGF and generate walk\-in traffic.
* Identify new business hubs, growth corridors, and underserved pockets within the catchment; report to BM for territory planning.
* Distribute KGF marketing material — brochures, rate cards, scheme flyers — during field visits and community outreach.
* Maintain a field visit log — customer name, location, purpose, outcome, and follow\-up date — submitted daily to BM.

**D. Customer Relationship Management**

* Build strong, trust\-based relationships with existing customers — visit personally at loan renewal and overdue milestones.
* Educate customers on KGF gold loan products, interest rates, schemes, and repayment options — accurate information only.
* Handle customer queries and concerns in the field; escalate unresolved issues to BM without delay.
* Maintain customer contact details updated in the system — phone number, address, and alternate contact verified at every interaction.
* Support ABM in collecting overdue amounts from field customers — soft follow\-up visits and negotiated repayment commitments.
* Ensure every customer leaves with a positive KGF experience — conduct, language, and professionalism at all times.

**E. Collections Support**

* Assist ABM in overdue recovery — visit 30\-day and 60\-day bucket customers in the field for soft collection follow\-up.
* Communicate repayment reminders to customers approaching due dates — calls and field visits as directed by ABM.
* Collect overdue amounts from field customers where authorised by BM; deposit collected cash to branch cashier same day without exception.
* Never retain any collected cash overnight — any deviation treated as a serious compliance breach.
* Report field customer feedback on repayment difficulty or gold valuation concerns to ABM for resolution.

**F. Documentation \& Compliance**

* Assist customers in completing KYC documentation at the field stage — check completeness before bringing to branch.
* Never promise interest rates, LTV ratios, or loan amounts not sanctioned by KGF credit policy — refer to published scheme cards.
* Comply with KGF code of conduct during all field visits — no soliciting of gifts, commissions, or personal favours from customers.
* Report any competitor activity, fraudulent gold pledging attempts, or suspicious customer behaviour to BM immediately.
* Maintain accurate and honest reporting of field activity — fabricated visit logs treated as gross misconduct.

**G. Reporting \& MIS**

* Submit end\-of\-day field activity report to BM — visits completed, leads generated, disbursements supported, next\-day plan.
* Maintain personal lead tracker — source, contact details, loan requirement, status, and follow\-up schedule.
* Attend weekly performance review with BM — present lead pipeline, conversion status, and reasons for gaps.
* Contribute to branch monthly business plan — provide bottom\-up lead and disbursement forecast for SO territory.

**ELIGIBILITY \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Graduate in any discipline — B.Com / BBA preferred; HSC with strong field experience also considered.
* 1–4 years of field sales experience in NBFC, gold loan, microfinance, insurance, or banking sector.
* Freshers with strong communication skills, local market knowledge, and self\-motivation considered for trainee roles.
* Working knowledge of gold loan products, interest calculation, and KYC norms preferred.
* Strong Tamil communication — ability to converse confidently with diverse customer profiles in the local market.
* Two\-wheeler licence and own vehicle mandatory — daily field coverage across branch catchment required.
* Mobile proficiency — lead tracking app, WhatsApp business communication, and basic MIS reporting.

**KEY SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

* Field sales and prospecting **Customer acquisition and lead conversion**
* Local market and community knowledge **Persuasion and objection handling**
* Gold loan product knowledge **Relationship building and retention**
* Time management and beat planning **Reporting discipline and data accuracy**

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* **Monthly disbursement target —** % of individual target achieved — primary performance metric.
* **New customer acquisition —** number of first\-time borrowers onboarded per month.
* **Lead conversion rate —** % of generated leads converted to disbursed loans.
* **Renewal conversion —** % of due\-for\-renewal accounts converted before loan expiry.
* **Referral generation —** number of active referrals collected and converted per month.
* **Field visit compliance —** daily beat plan completion — visits logged vs target.
* **Collections support —** % of assigned overdue accounts contacted and followed up in the month.
* **Documentation accuracy —** % of customer files brought to branch with complete KYC — zero rejection rate at counter.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**

* Salary: As per company norms — commensurate with experience and market.
* Performance incentive: Monthly payout linked to disbursement achievement and new customer acquisition — uncapped for top performers.
* Field allowance: Travel reimbursement as per KGF field staff policy.
* EPF \& ESI: As per statutory norms.
* Annual increment: Based on performance appraisal.
* Career progression: High\-performing Sales Officers considered for Senior Sales Officer and Assistant Branch Manager roles.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

* Flexible schedule

* Provident Fund

title: Associate Product Manager
job_function: Product Management, Production, and Business Development
description:
**About Company:** 




 Our Client is building the Intent Layer for AI\-driven software: the layer that makes sure what a business actually intends is what its AI\-built software ships. Our enterprise product is live in early access. We are founder\-led, customer\-focused, and building something genuinely new in one of the most exciting corners of AI.
 



  





 You would work directly with our founder, who spent 25 years building AI and product at Google and Adobe. For an early\-career PM, that is a rare apprenticeship. You learn product craft from someone who has done it at the highest level, on a real, live product.
 



  





**About Role:** 




 This is a hands\-on Product Manager role, working shoulder to shoulder with the founder. Your job is to take the product from idea to shipped: turn direction into clear specs, keep the modules and projects moving, coordinate with engineering, and close the loop with what customers actually need.
 



  





 A defining part of this role is leverage through AI. We build with cutting\-edge AI tools, and you will learn to use them, Claude and others, to do the work of a much larger team: drafting specs, shaping designs, analyzing feedback, and moving faster than a traditional PM ever could. If the idea of amplifying yourself several times over with AI excites you, you will thrive here.
 



  





 We are clear about the stage. This is an early, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves role with real ownership and real mentorship, not a big\-company seat where you own one slice of a slide. You will touch the whole product.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





 \- Turn direction into execution:\*\* write clear specs and PRDs, break work into projects, and keep everything moving to done.
 



 \- Drive the modules and projects:\*\* own day\-to\-day coordination across the product, track progress, and unblock.
 



 \- Amplify with AI:\*\* use Claude and other AI tools to draft, design, analyze, and ship faster, and become the person who gets the most out of them.
 



 \- Shape the design:\*\* use Claude Design and Figma to turn product needs into wireframes and flows the team can build from.
 



 \- Work with engineering:\*\* translate product intent into something the team can build, and keep the build aligned to it.
 



 \-Stay close to customers:\*\* turn pilot feedback into clear product improvements.
 



 \- Bring order:\*\* documentation, priorities, and follow\-through, so the founder can focus on the hardest calls.
 



  





**What you'll bring** 




 \- 1\-2 years in a product role\*\*, ideally touching B2B or enterprise software.
 



 \- Strong communication and organization:\*\* you write clearly, structure ambiguity, and follow through.
 



 \- Fluency, or fast fluency, with AI tools:\*\* you already use tools like Claude to work smarter, or you will pick them up fast and run. This is central to the role.
 



 \- Design fluency: a good eye for product design and usability, and comfort turning ideas into wireframes and flows with tools like Claude Design and Figma. You do not need to be a visual designer, but you should be able to shape and iterate on design.
 



 \- Analytical skills: you use data to inform decisions, dig into user feedback and product metrics, and structure ambiguous problems with evidence rather than opinion.
 



 \- Product instinct: you think about the user and the "why," not just the task.
 



 \- A builder's temperament: comfortable with ambiguity, hungry to learn, and happy owning a problem end to end without a fully specified ticket.
 



 \- A degree in any field. A B\-school background is a plus, not a requirement.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




  





 \- Exposure to B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
 



 \- Enough technical literacy to talk to engineers.
 



 \- Early\-stage or startup experience.
 



  





**Why join us** 




  





 \- Learn from a founder who has built at the top.\*\* 25 years of product at Google and Adobe, mentoring you directly. Most early\-career PMs wait years for that kind of access.
 



 \- Real ownership, real scope.\*\* You will shape the whole product, not one corner of it, and watch your work ship.
 



 \- Become AI\-native.\*\* You will build what is fast becoming the most valuable skill in the field: getting several times the output from AI tools.
 



 \- Grounded, not hype\-driven.\*\* We are customer\-focused and build deliberately, at a sustainable pace. We hire carefully and invest in the people we bring on for the long run.
 



 \- You will grow fast.\*\* A year here, with this scope and this mentorship, is worth several elsewhere.

title: Associate Product Manager

description:
**About the Role :** 




 At Juspay, Associate Product managers take end to end product ownership, juggling between building the product, managing operations and evangelizing our creation with our customers.
 



  





**Being a Creator** 
 :
 



 Can PMs become TRUE creators? Can they CODE? Can they Design? Can they analyze data programmatically?
 



 Yes they do it here! We offer unique opportunities for PMs to upskill themselves and overlap with Devs and Designers. We believe PMs should participate in the creation process and make product specifications that is close to implementation.
 



  





**They Should :** 



* Own the vision of the organization
* Develop and foster a deep understanding of
* *Domain* 
 \- Payments
* *Technology* 
 \- Purescript/Haskell
* *Design* 
 \- Mobile UX/UI (Tools: Sketch, Flinto)
* *Data* 
 \- Payments user journey and conversions (Tools: SQL, Tableau \& data science programming)
* Deliver impactful and time\-bound results by getting hands on with all aspects of product development and leading by example
* Develop framework solutions that solve problems fundamentally
* Enable, Collaborate \& Coordinate with various stakeholders to craft the optimal product
* *Internal* 
 \- Technical Product Analysts (TPAs), Developers, Designers, Business Development and Senior Management
* *External* 
 \- CxOs, Sr. Executives, PMs and Devs of Merchants, Banks and Vendors
* Improve \& optimise product development processes continuously



  





**Apply if you have :** 



1. Aspiration for value creation
2. Aspiration for quality
3. Genuine user empathy
4. Openness and patience to learn harder things
5. Systematic approach to problem solving
6. Attitude and ability to get\-things\-done
7. Effectively balance big picture / details
8. Self\-motivated and driven
9. Persuasive without being forceful
10. The Giver attitude



  





**Preferred Qualifications And Skills** 




  




* MBA with 1\-3 years of professional experience in Product Management.
* Strong strategic mindset along with exceptional execution capabilities and rigor.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to plan, coordinate and execute assigned tasks via collaboration with multiple cross functional teams



  





**Why work in Juspay?** 




  





***Payments.. big deal?***




 Yes, it is a big deal. The wind is strongly blowing in favor of electronic payments \- India wants to buy/order everything online, go cashless (regulation) and can’t have enough of using smartphones! Startups and internet businesses currently see a payment’ success rate of 60% ( 40 out of 100 people fail during the payments process!). These businesses that will define our future are absolutely dependent on solving digital payments. Big industry with bigger problems to solve!
 



  





***How can Engineering solve this?***




 Payments is a complex ecosystem involving banks, RBI regulations, payment networks, telecom infrastructure, online and offline merchants. There is no way to align all these stars without radical engineering innovation. Talk to us about it.
 



  





***What does Juspay offer?***




 You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs. We live \& breathe the art of building amazing products with impeccable design and engineering. We want more innovators and a little bit of madness to take it further. For us office is like home with everything needed to make us comfortably code all day and chill out too. We have a full size piano, drums and a Shruti box if you are into music :) Lots of books, pictionary and interesting people to talk to about varied subjects \- art, philosophy and of course about how to do the highest feats of engineering/design. We take an active interest in helping people reach their highest potential.
